fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Overseas Scholarship For Students With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for regular, full-time students with disabilities to obtain higher education viz., Master's degree, or Ph.D. courses from foreign universities, in one of the specified fields of study.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship Students With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by DoEPwD for students with disabilities pursuing a post-matric qualification from UGC/AICTE recognized universities, i.e. students of Class 11th, Class 12th, including Polytechnics, Post-Matriculation Diploma/Certificates and Bachelor’s/Master’s Degree/Diploma in India.

fields.schemeName: Emeritus Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: A fellowship scheme by University Grants Commission to provide an opportunity to superannuated teachers to pursue active research in their respective field of specialization in Indian Universities/Colleges/ Institutions.

fields.schemeName: Research Grant For In-Service Faculty Members
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Research Grant for In-Service Faculty Members" was introduced by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education (DoHE). The objective of this research grant is to provide opportunities to regularly appointed faculty members of Universities/ Institutes/ Colleges.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme For The Students Belonging To Scheduled Tribe For Studies In India
fields.briefDescription: This is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, for the students of Scheduled Tribe (ST) for studies in India. This scheme is for pursuing higher education starting from class XI to Post Graduation courses in India.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scholarship is designed to provide OBC students with the necessary financial resources studying at pre-matriculation stage to enable them to complete their education.

fields.schemeName: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
fields.briefDescription: The Ministry of External Affairs launched the first edition of the Internship Programme in 2022. The internship policy aims to take foreign policy closer to the people. A total of 75 internships will be offered in the year 2022 in a single term of three months during April to June 2022.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship For Cadets Of Sainik School Imphal
fields.briefDescription:
The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently
residing in the States of studying at Sainik School Imphal, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces.

fields.schemeName: Kanyashree Prakalpa
fields.briefDescription: The scheme to improve the status and wellbeing of girls, specifically those from socio-economically disadvantaged families, through Conditional Cash Transfers by: Incentivising them to continue in education for a longer period of time, and complete secondary or higher secondary education.

fields.schemeName: Merit Awards
fields.briefDescription: In the "Merit Awards" scheme, awards are given to the students with disability who rank 1st, 2nd, and 3rd among disabled students in the Secondary School Certificate (S.S.C.) and Higher Secondary Certificate (H.S.C.)  in their respective divisional boards of education.

fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship To VJNT Students - Maharashtra
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme namely “Post-Matric Scholarship to VJNT students” to encourage the students of the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) to undergo Post-Matric Courses.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogayog Yojana-Special
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to digitally empower students and help them leverage the advantages of an interconnected world.

fields.schemeName: Opening And Running Junior Colleges For VJNT Students Run By Voluntary Agencies
fields.briefDescription: The Govt. of Maharashtra vide G.R. dated 26/6/2008 launched the scheme “Opening and Running Junior Colleges for VJNT Students Run by Voluntary Agencies” for the educational and social development of Vimukta Jatis and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.

fields.schemeName: State Post-metric Scholarship For Disabled
fields.briefDescription: The "State Post-metric Scholarship for Disabled" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students with disability (SwDs) to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Saraswati Cycle Yojana
fields.briefDescription:
Chhattisgarh Saraswati Cycle Yojana has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh in 2004. 
Saraswati Cycle Yojana is being operated by the Department of School Education, Government of Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award (APB&OCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Cash Award” was started by the Department of Labour and Employment, Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh for the registered workers of Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).

fields.schemeName: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Bihar Government launched the Bihar Student Credit Card (BSCC) scheme to provide financial aid to applicants to complete their higher education.

fields.schemeName: Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under MP Shram Kalyan Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana, scholarships will be provided to the students in the state to continue their education.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance Allowance To Backward Class Students Under Training In Sainik Schools
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Maintenance Allowance to Backward Class Students Under Training in Sainik School” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Study In Abroad
fields.briefDescription: In the year 2010-11, Rajasthan Government has taken the initiative to encourage girl child education by starting a scheme to Study Abroad.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Higher Education For Persons With Special Needs
fields.briefDescription: The Persons with Disabilities Act 1995 indicates that differently-abled persons should have access to education at all levels. In the higher education sector, the University Grants Commission (UGC) is supporting universities and colleges in the country to involve in special education activities.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Pre-Matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of Very Backward Class students.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: National Solar Science Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The “National Solar Science Fellowship Programme” of the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy was launched in February 2011. The aim of the National Solar Science Fellowship Programme is to provide a platform to top-quality scientists and engineers in the area of solar energy research.

fields.schemeName: Indirect Tax Internship Scheme In Central Board Of Indirect Taxes And Customs (CBIC)
fields.briefDescription: The "Indirect Tax Internship Scheme" by CBIC takes Law Students/ Graduates as Interns every year. The interns are expected to study case files, assist in legal research and drafting of petitions, brief the counsels and extend any other related legal/general assistance to officers/counsels.

fields.schemeName: Widow B.Ed Scheme-Rajasthan
fields.briefDescription: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Widow B.Ed Scheme" for Widow/abandoned women.

fields.schemeName: Summer Internship Scheme Of DGFT
fields.briefDescription: The Summer Internship Scheme by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade is for the interaction of the officers of the Directorate with young scholars and researchers with brilliant academic backgrounds from reputed academic institutions pursuing Studies/Research in Public Policy/Economics/Law etc.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
fields.schemeName: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: CVC initiated an Internship Scheme in the year 2016. This Scheme seeks to engage Indian Nationals, who are Graduates (awaiting final year results) /Post Graduate or Research Students enrolled in reputed Universities/Institutions in India or abroad.

fields.schemeName: Super 5000
fields.briefDescription: In 2017, Madhya Pradesh State Government started a scheme "Super 5000" for student scholarships.

fields.schemeName: Kerala Biotechnology Re-Entry Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: “Kerala Biotechnology Re-Entry Fellowship (K-BiREF)” is a fellowship programme to attract well-trained and highly skilled researchers with a good track record (Indian nationals) working abroad in various frontier areas in biotechnology to research and academic institutions in Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Government of Goa State Scholarship to NDA Cadets
fields.briefDescription: The scheme supports NDA cadets from humble financial backgrounds undergoing training at NDA. The scheme aims to attract cadets from economically disadvantaged sections of society opting to serve the country by taking up such challenging jobs/training.

fields.schemeName: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana - Coaching To Scheduled Tribe Student Studying In Class Xth, XIth & XIIth
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to impart coaching to ST students across Goa studying in classes Xth, XIth (Science), and XIIth (Arts, Science and Commerce). The scheme prepares the students for various professional courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Architecture, Paramedical Sciences, Law, etc.

fields.schemeName: KSCSTE Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: KSCSTE Post-Doctoral Fellowships will be provided to those who possess Ph.D. in science and engineering with high quality research publications in SCI journals. The program aims to encourage Ph.D. holders to pursue further research and to develop career as scientist.

fields.schemeName: Back-To-Lab Post-Doctoral Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The “Back-to-Lab” programme of Women Scientists Division offers Research and Post-Doctoral Fellowship to women who have break in their career, to facilitate their re-entry in science research.

fields.schemeName: D. D. Kosambi Research Fellowship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed by the Directorate of Art and Culture, Government of Goa to encourage Goan Scholars to undertake research in the field of Goan history, culture, arts, social studies etc. Three fellowships shall be awarded.

fields.schemeName: OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme “OEC Pre-matric Educational Assistance” was started by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala to provide educational assistance to pre-matric students belonging to these communities who are studying in Government/Aided/Unaided schools from Classes 1st to 10th.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
fields.briefDescription: "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes for Studies in India" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The objective is to award scholarships to school-going children of poorer OBC parents.

fields.schemeName: Technology Fellowship and Patent Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to identify technology educators in technical educational institutes in Goa who are keen to further their expertise. The selected educators/fellows would be sent to Centres of Excellence within the country and abroad to undertake summer school and short-term training.

fields.schemeName: Award of Adhoc Merit Grant (Special Incentive) to Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented as a sort of encouragement for the Scheduled Caste students who secure 65% or above marks in matriculation/SSLC Board of Examinations.

fields.schemeName: Grant Of Retention Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Girl Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste Girls Students to pursue their studies in Primary Education. Because of this assistance, the parents of those students may not lose any income that they would otherwise get by sending their girls to work.

fields.schemeName: Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Opening and Maintenance of Boys and Girls Hostels” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry, provides boarding/lodging and hostel facilities to Scheduled Caste students in pursuance of their education and to dissuade dropping of education at school and college level.

fields.schemeName: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation
fields.briefDescription: "Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to the Students Whose Parents Are Engaged in Unclean Occupation” by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry, provides scholarships to the students whose parents are engaged in unclean occupations to improve the status of the unprivileged society.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to the Ward of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of scholarship shall be granted to the children/wards of workers who are registered under the CBOCWWB on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in 10th, 12th & Graduation.

fields.schemeName: Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Awasiye Vidyala Yojana" initiated by the Labor Department of the Uttar Pradesh State for the education of the construction worker.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana" to help the children of construction workers.

fields.schemeName: Agriculture Academic Studies Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Scheme is to sponsor students for undergoing 4 years of Graduate/degree courses in Agriculture/Horticulture against State quota seats in different Agriculture Universities in the country.

fields.schemeName: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan - Internship Program
fields.briefDescription: The 'Internship Program' as part of the Framework for Implementation of Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Revamped Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA) (2022-23 to 2025-26) of the Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), Government of India (Gol), seeks to engage 'Students'.

fields.schemeName: Lakshya Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support in the form of scholarships to candidates who are permanent residents of Tripura and clear the Civil Service Examination (Prelims/Mains) conducted by UPSC.

fields.schemeName: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna -RS-CIT
fields.briefDescription: The objective of Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna is to provide empowerment to the girls and women of the state in the field of computers by providing free computer courses to them.

fields.schemeName: Tablet Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students of 12th Standard
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of ₹1,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses (Swami Vivekanand Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, a monthly stipend/scholarship will be given to Scheduled Caste Category students who are studying professional courses in Government or Private Industrial Training Institute (ITI).

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "Reimbursement of Tuition Fees to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM studying in Government-recognized Institutions are provided reimbursement of their tuition fees.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship for Madhya Pradesh is provide financial assistance to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded - Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The 'Government Institute for the Mentally Retarded,Chennai' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, children with intellectual disability are given special education, vocational training, food, uniforms etc.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
fields.briefDescription: The 'Scholarship (I to VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to purchase notebooks for differently-abled students studying in government school.

fields.schemeName: Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Sikkim has introduced the Sikkim Grant of Scholarship to Students with Disabilities Scheme, 2014. This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to differently-abled students to help them secure academic education and technical or professional training.

fields.schemeName: National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The “National Centre for Earth Science Studies Internship” scheme by the Earth System Science Organization, Ministry of Earth Sciences, provides various opportunities for school as well as college students to familiarise and/or pursue research on different branches of earth sciences.

fields.schemeName: Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education
fields.briefDescription: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation launched the “Veda Vyasa Scheme for Vedic Education” for the year 2019-20, to encourage Vedic Education in Andhra Pradesh.  Under this scheme, selected applicants will be granted Annual Financial Assistance.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class
fields.briefDescription: "The Bharati Scheme for Education - 1st Class to 5th Class" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.  Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Intern (IPCC)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin students.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Graduation (Any regular course of 3 years duration after 10+2 will be considered under this category. i.e., B.A., B.Com, B.Sc., etc., including B.Ed.)" provides financial assistance to encourage Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.

fields.schemeName: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to motivate girls towards education. Under this scheme, girls in Class 11th who have passed their 10th class examination will receive ₹3,000/- per year as a monetary incentive.

fields.schemeName: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to motivate students from the lower economic backgrounds & support them economically. Under this scheme, cash award of ₹5,000/- is given to the students who have obtained the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district.

fields.schemeName: Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide facilities for residential and other facilities such as water, reimbursement of electricity expenditure, scholarship etc. for scheduled caste students of Madhya Pradesh studying in higher institutions located in Delhi.

fields.schemeName: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students and improve their educational status. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

fields.schemeName: Pratibha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed national competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, and NDA, and have taken admission in IIT, NIT, NLU, MBBS (government colleges located in Madhya Pradesh), AIIMS or NDA.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Evam Anusuchit Janjati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The “Mukhyamantri Anusoochit Jaati Evam Anusoochit Janajati Chhatrawas Anudan Yojana” was launched by the SC and ST Welfare Department, Government of Bihar aims to provide financial assistance in every month to the students studying in Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe hostels.

fields.schemeName: Research Scholarship for Disabled Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial support for PhD research to differently-abled students. Eligible candidates receive ₹16,000/- per month, which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.

fields.schemeName: Sanskrit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, students studying Sanskrit at various levels—Post Graduate (M.A. Classic), Acharya, Graduate (B.A. Classic), Shastri, Uttar Madhyama, Purva Madhyama, and Prathama—in any government or aided non-government college receive a monthly scholarship of ₹300/- for 10 months.

fields.schemeName: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: The NSFDC Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "The NSFDC Internship Scheme 2024" is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. The internship will expose students to various programs & schemes undertaken by NSFDC, offering them hands-on experience in

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Beneficiary" welfare scheme launched by the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides one-time financial assistance for the education of children.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Hostels: Special Guides
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides hostel facilities to all boys and girls boarders studying up to XII Standard.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial assistance to students from Backward Classes (BC) and Most Backward Classes (MBC) studying in English medium from 6th to 10th standard. It covers tuition and examination fees.

fields.schemeName: Children Education Allowance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Nagaland Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board, Under this scheme, children of registered beneficiaries studying from Nursery to Class 10 are provided ₹500/- per month per child as education assistance.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to the Children Studying in 1st to 7th and 8th to 10th Class
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, educational assistance is provided of ₹2,500/- to the children studying in 1st to 7th standard and ₹5,000/- for the children studying in 8th to 10th standard of the registered construction worker. The scheme covers up to two children and the wife of a registered male worker.

fields.schemeName: Schooling Education (JKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Schooling Education" by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., J&K, provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers, from Class Nursery/1st to 5th, and from Class 6th to 8th.

fields.schemeName: Kanya Dhan Scheme for SC Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Kanya Dhan Scheme for SC Students" by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, an amount of ₹ 25,000/- is provided to the girl students of the Scheduled Caste Communities once they pass the 12th standard board examination (or equivalent).

fields.schemeName: Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)
fields.briefDescription: "Pre Matric Scholarship Scheme (Saral Vidya Sahay) for SC and OBC (V to VIII)" was introduced by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. The scheme aims to support parents of children belonging to Scheduled Castes and Other Backward Classes for the education of their wards.

fields.schemeName: Handicapped Students Stipend Mizoram
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, provide financial support to differently-abled students for purchasing essential items like books and uniforms. Students enrolled in both government and private schools are eligible to receive a monthly stipend.

fields.schemeName: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana was initiated by the "Department of Women, Child Development, and Social Security, Government of Jharkhand."

fields.schemeName: State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a scholarship amount of ₹200/- to Scheduled Caste students, which is disbursed until 31st October every year.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Backward Classes Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to enhance educational opportunities and participation among students belonging to backward classes in Jharkhand. It provides financial assistance to reduce dropout rates from classes 1 to 10 and promote equality in education.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" promotes higher education among Scheduled Caste students in Jharkhand by providing financial assistance. This scheme aims to increase the participation of SC students in post-matric education.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students" aims to provide financial assistance to backward class students studying at the pre-matriculation level in India. Monthly scholarships of varying amounts are provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship Scheme" provides financial assistance to deserving Scheduled Tribes, Scheduled Castes, Minorities, and Backward Class students for pursuing postgraduate education in top-ranked universities abroad.

fields.schemeName: Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY)
fields.briefDescription: "Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY)" is a flagship program launched by the Government of Bihar to uplift ultra-poor households through comprehensive livelihood support, skill-building, and financial inclusion.

fields.schemeName: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools
fields.briefDescription: The "Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, reimburses tuition fees for eligible students enrolled in Sainik Schools or Institutions.

fields.schemeName: Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: The "Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides an incentive amount to encourage SC/ST candidates to appear in Civil Services Examinations.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Student for Studies in India
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Students for Studies in India" aims to provide financial assistance to students from the Lower Income Groups to enable them to complete their education. Students are provided maintenance allowances, tuition fees, and additional benefits.

fields.schemeName: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2007, the "Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to backward class students for postgraduate, Ph.D., and post-research studies abroad.

fields.schemeName: Laptop Supply Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Laptop Supply Scheme" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides ₹25,000/- for purchasing a laptop to students who score 80% or more in 12th Standard from a Government Higher Secondary School or a Madhya Pradesh Board (MP Board) affiliated school.

fields.schemeName: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from BPL students to support their education. Under this scheme, a monthly stipend is provided to students studying in classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools.

fields.schemeName: Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC
fields.briefDescription: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" Scheme by the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial assistance to meritorious SC students for pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities in Humanities and Social Sciences.

fields.schemeName: Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide additional financial assistance of ₹500/- per month to children of individuals working in cleaning/sanitation profession. This assistance is given to students already receiving a scholarship under Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, ensuring their continued education.

fields.schemeName: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher and technical education among transgender individuals by providing financial assistance for their educational expenses. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a refund of their school, college, higher, or technical education fees.

fields.schemeName: Educational Study Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Educational Study Scheme" provides financial assistance in the form of loans for self-supporting graduate-level courses in professional fields such as Medical, Dental, Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy, Architecture, Nursing, Homeopathy, Veterinary, and similar disciplines.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support SC students for higher education abroad in fields like Engineering, Sciences, and Humanities. Benefits include up to ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. and ₹10,00,000 for Masters, with eligibility criteria including residency and income below ₹8,00,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational & technical education & have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or from any other source.

fields.schemeName: Free Supply of Text Books
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides textbooks or cash subsidies for textbooks and writing materials to students of Government and Aided Schools. Benefits include financial assistance ranging from ₹550/- to ₹830/- per annum, with additional support for geometry boxes. All students from Nursery to 12th are eligible.

fields.schemeName: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide quality education and holistic development opportunities for girls from backward and extremely backward classes. Free education, accommodation, study material, medical support, and skill development programs are provided.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide ₹10,000/- as a one-time scholarship to extremely backward class students passing class 10th in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board.

fields.schemeName: Merit Scholarship: Engineering University
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides ₹1000/- per month to eligible students for pursuing B.E. from a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh.  The applicants can either be students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations, or Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E.

fields.schemeName: Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
fields.briefDescription: "Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized polytechnic institutions in Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.

fields.schemeName: Aapki Beti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools, belonging to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose both or one parent has passed away. Girls studying in Class 9 to 12 receive ₹2,500/- per year.

fields.schemeName: ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Doctoral Fellowships to support full-time Ph.D. scholars engaged in high-quality research in the field of social and human sciences. These fellowships are awarded to Indian research scholars registered in Ph.D. programs at UGC-recognized u

fields.schemeName: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing free Sanskrit textbooks to students studying in Classes 1 to 12. Under this scheme, annual financial assistance ranging from ₹250/- to ₹700/- is provided to each student enrolled in Classes 1 to 12 of Sanskrit schools.

fields.schemeName: Sero Positive Illness Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Sero Positive Illness Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to provide educational scholarships to orphaned and destitute children affected by Sero Positive illness.

fields.schemeName: Foreign Study Loan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories for pursuing higher studies abroad in medical and post-graduation courses. It offers loans up to ₹15,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to SC students studying in selected schools under Talentpool Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide the best education to meritorious Scheduled Caste students in high-quality residential schools to help them build their careers and improve their living standards.

fields.schemeName: Educational Loan Scheme (GMFDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for technical and non-technical education that creates employment or job opportunities for beneficiaries. Through this scheme, loans are provided to eligible students from minority communities for studies within India and abroad.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Class
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial aid to promote education. Scholarships are provided to eligible students of Standards 1 to 10.

fields.schemeName: Educational Loan Scheme (GBCDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support to students from socially and educationally backward classes for higher technical and professional education. It offers loans at concessional interest rates for approved graduate and postgraduate courses like engineering, medical, MBA, MCA, and more.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims at generating a total of 1000 Full-time PhD Candidates in emerging research areas of Electronic System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Part Time PhD Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims at generating a total of 150 Part-time PhDs in emerging research areas of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships
fields.briefDescription: This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5 years based on performance review.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme supports school education by providing annual scholarships to students from Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes studying in standards 1st to 10th.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Puraskar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students and provides cash prizes to those who secure first, second, or third positions in their graduation or post-graduation studies at the university level.

fields.schemeName: Rishi and Milan Khosla Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher education among girl students in the state by providing scholarships to those pursuing their first year of post-graduation in various government colleges across Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Sanskrit Chhatra Pratibha Samman
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students to pursue higher studies in Sanskrit by rewarding those who achieve top positions in the subject at the high school, intermediate, undergraduate, and postgraduate levels.

fields.schemeName: Saksham Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support meritorious differently-abled students pursuing graduate-level studies in the state by providing them with financial assistance in the form of scholarships.

fields.schemeName: Shridev Suman State Merit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to meritorious students who qualify in eligibility test conducted by SCERT Uttarakhand. The scholarship is awarded to the next 5 students from each development block of Uttarakhand who are not selected for the Dr. Shivanand Nautiyal Scholarship.

fields.schemeName: Vidhya Sadhana Yojana Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycles are gifted to girl students across Gujarat to reduce school dropouts among scheduled tribe girls after class 8.

fields.schemeName: Higher Education Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage children of workers and reduce financial burden of education through higher educational assistance. It provides ₹20,000/- for Bachelor of Medicine Bachelor of Surgery admission and ₹10,000/- for other graduate courses to merit students.

fields.schemeName: Enhancement of Spoken English Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the spoken English skills of students of Classes 9 to 12 studying in all government schools across the districts of the state of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: 6% Interest Subsidy on Loans taken through Banks for Study Abroad
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce financial stress for ST students pursuing foreign education by providing up to ₹1,50,000 subsidy on interest for 3 years.

fields.schemeName: Amit Gautam Memorial Scholarship (B.Tech in Electronics Engineering – 4th Year)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support meritorious students pursuing a B.Tech in Electronics Engineering who are in their 4th year of study by providing a one-year scholarship amounting to ₹7,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Hands-on Training and Exposure Visits under Experiential Learning
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free one-week residential hands-on certificate training programs to undergraduate, postgraduate students, researchers, and faculty members, including accommodation and meals.

fields.schemeName: Scheme To Provide Assistance To Students Seeking Education Outside Goa In Any Field Of Art And Culture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage young talents in Goa to achieve the highest possible standard in fields of Art and Culture by providing financial support for training outside the State. Assistance is provided to eligible students for basic or advanced education in art.

fields.schemeName: One-day Seminar on Vedic Mathematics
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a common platform for officers, teachers, and students from universities, colleges, schools, and other departments to actively participate and gain knowledge about the simplified curriculum of Vedic Mathematics and its easy-to-apply methods.

fields.schemeName: Ashramshalas (Grant in Aid)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide schooling, boarding and lodging to Scheduled Tribe students at a single location, enabling better employment opportunities and competitive equality with other sections of society. The scheme offers residential education with complete support including free education.

fields.schemeName: Establishment and Operation of STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) Laboratories
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to establish STEM laboratories in schools across Uttarakhand to provide students of classes 6 to 12 with hands-on science, technology, engineering, and mathematics learning opportunities and strengthen their practical understanding of scientific concepts.

fields.schemeName: Scheme To Provide Grant To The Institution(s)/Individual(s) For Long Term Project In The Field Of Art And Culture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to give financial support to institution(s)/individual(s) involved in long term projects in the field of Art and Culture. It provides a maximum grant of ₹5,00,000/- per annum to eligible organizations and individuals, while also encouraging young talent and offering scholarships.

fields.schemeName: Free Uniforms for Students
fields.briefDescription: This scheme Launched on 1 July 2004 with the aims to ensure regular attendance and continuity in education by offering uniform assistance to both boys and girls enrolled in Classes 1 to 8.

fields.schemeName: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Lakshya Siddhi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance, in the form of a Scholarship, proportionate to the fees paid by Scheduled Tribe students at the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC) level in order to take offline coaching assistance through reputed institutions for preparation for NEET & JEE.

fields.schemeName: ST Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe girl students of Madhya Pradesh enrolled in Class 11 to encourage them to continue their education and prevent dropouts.

fields.schemeName: Award of Cash Incentive to the Toppers at Regional Level and Students Scoring Centum in the Subjects Involving Theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to award cash incentives to encourage students in their education by recognizing top three regional rank holders and those scoring centum in theory subjects in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Exams in Govt. Schools.

fields.schemeName: Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a one-time incentive of ₹10,000/- to students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared High School Leaving Certificate or Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate examinations during the current year.

fields.schemeName: Nishadraj Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher education among children of fisher families working in federation reservoirs by providing scholarships of up to ₹20,000 for technical courses and up to ₹10,000 for non-technical courses.

fields.schemeName: Maulana Azad Education Finance Foundation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide interest-free loans of up to ₹5 lakh to students from minority communities for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the higher education of dependents of ex-servicemen by providing financial assistance for pursuing engineering, medical, and PhD courses. Under this scheme, annual scholarships are awarded to beneficiaries based on their course of study.

fields.schemeName: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free textbooks to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in government and government-aided schools, as well as recognized madrasas that follow the state government curriculum.

fields.schemeName: Uchcha Shiksha Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote higher education among meritorious students by providing financial support to regular undergraduate and postgraduate students in government colleges and state universities of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Dr. A.N. Mukhopadhyay Needy Student Fund (B.Sc. Agriculture - Final Year Student)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per year to meritorious & needy students pursuing B.Sc. Agriculture course in their final year of study, based on their genuine financial need, thereby helping to reduce their economic burden & support the continuation of their education.

fields.schemeName: Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 1 to 8 by offering free education and essential learning materials, including books, shoe-bags, and meals, across all government and non-government schools in the state.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship on Merit Basis
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate studies at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University by awarding scholarships to those who secure the highest marks in the relevant course, class, or subject.

fields.schemeName: Priyank Pathak Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture (4th Year) Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. in Agriculture who are in their fourth year of study, by awarding them a monthly scholarship of ₹ 800/- for one year.

fields.schemeName: Special Financial Assistance Scheme for Meritorious Students of the State for Preparation of Competitive Examinations
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support of ₹50,000/- to meritorious students who have cleared the preliminary examination conducted by the State or Union Public Service Commission for Group 'A' and 'B' services, or the written examination for the Armed Forces (e.g., NDA, CDS, OTA, etc.).

fields.schemeName: Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 2012-13 by the Govt. of Himachal Pradesh, the "Kalpana Chawla Chatravriti Yojana" is a scholarship scheme that provides financial assistance to girls from economically weaker sections to pursue higher education without any financial burden, and achieve their career goals.

fields.schemeName: Sweekruti: Pre & Post Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Transgender students studying at post matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships are available to transgender students  for studies in India only and awarded where the applicant is studying.

fields.schemeName: Rehabilitation of Cured Leprosy Persons: Pre & Post-Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the parents of Cured Leprosy Persons in order to support such parents in successfully bringing up their children against societal intolerance, stigma, discrimination and violence.

fields.schemeName: Biju Yuva Sashaktikaran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹30,000/-, which is transferred directly to the bank accounts of 15,000 meritorious +2 students through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for the purchase of a laptop.

fields.schemeName: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Diploma Level
fields.briefDescription: This scholarship will be awarded to students who are pursuing Diploma level Courses in Engineering/Technology including Architectural Assistantship or any other equivalent courses as approved by the All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE).

fields.schemeName: Award For Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya In The HSSLC Examination (Science Stream)
fields.briefDescription: The Directorate of Educational Research & Training Meghalaya, Shillong is implementing a scheme in providing a one-time award for meritorious tribal students of Meghalaya who passed the current HSSLC Examination (Science) every year.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Dr. Ambedkar Medhavi Chhatravriti Yojna to Other Backward Classes Students” was started by Dept. of Education, H.P. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to top 1000 meritorious students of OBC declared as such in the result of Matric Examination conducted by H.P. Board.

fields.schemeName: Vidyajyothi Scheme- Financial Aid For Uniforms And Study Materials To PH Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Vidyajyothi Scheme- Financial Aid for Uniforms and Study Materials to PH Students” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance For Children Of Victims Of Crime
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Educational Assistance for Children of Victims of Crime” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “State Talent Search Examination in Mathematics and Science for Tribal Students of Meghalaya at the Close of Upper Primary Stage (Class VIII)” was launched by the Education Department, Government of Meghalaya.

fields.schemeName: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through this scheme, scholarship will be provided every year to girl students living below the poverty line.

fields.schemeName: The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education)
fields.briefDescription: "The Meghalaya Tribal Students’ Book Grant (Post-Matric Education)" scheme was launched by the Directorate of Higher and Technical Education, Meghalaya. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the meritorious tribal students for the purchase of books for their studies.

fields.schemeName: Post-Graduate Scholarships for Professional Courses for SC/ST Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme has been initiated to provide opportunity to deprived sections of the society, viz. SC/ST for undertaking postgraduate level studies in Professional subjects like Engineering & Technology, Management, Pharmacy etc. in recognised Indian Universities/Institutions/Colleges.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University students
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Dept. of Higher Education to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. The scholarships are awarded on the basis of results of Higher Secondary / Class 12th Board Exam

fields.schemeName: Free Education For Sports Medal Winners / Participants Of National/ International Events
fields.briefDescription: The scheme of "Free Education for Sports Medal Winners / Participants of National/ International Events" is introduced by UGC, to provide financial assistance to the medal winners\ elite sports persons studying in universities/colleges leading to all the full-time regular courses.

fields.nodalMinistryName: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)
fields.schemeName: NITI Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: This Scheme seeks to engage students pursuing Under Graduate/Graduate/Post Graduate Degrees or are Research Scholars enrolled in recognized University/Institution within India or abroad, as "interns". They shall be given exposure to various Verticals/ Divisions/Units within NITI Aayog.

fields.schemeName: Merit Cum Means Linked Financial Assistance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: It is the policy of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi that students get access to high quality higher education provided by Delhi State Universities irrespective of their caste, creed, economic background, or gender.

fields.schemeName: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide merit-based financial assistance to children of CM-KISAN beneficiaries pursuing professional and technical courses, supporting higher education through Direct Benefit Transfer.

fields.schemeName: Scheduled Tribe Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe students of Uttarakhand from Class 11th onwards by providing financial assistance for their education, including tuition fees and other academic expenses.

fields.schemeName: Scheduled Tribe Purvadasham Scholarship Scheme (Class 1 to 8) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The aim of this scheme is to help Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1st to 8th by giving them financial support so they can continue their education without any financial difficulty.

fields.schemeName: Study in India Programme
fields.briefDescription: The Study in India Programme aims to promote India as a global education hub by offering centralized admissions, quality education, and visa support to international students.”

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Dr Ambedkar Central Sector Scheme of Interest Subsidy on Educational Loans for Overseas Studies for Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and Economically Backward Classes (EBCs)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides interest subsidy to the students belonging to the OBCs and EBCs on the interest payable for the period of the moratorium for the Education Loans for overseas studies to pursue approved courses of studies abroad at Masters, M.Phil. and PhD level.

fields.schemeName: Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers a financial incentive of up to ₹10,000/- to meritorious Other Backward Classes (OBC) students who have achieved 80% or higher marks in the HSSLC examination. The objective is to motivate and encourage OBC students to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Awarding Laptops To Meritorious Students Of Meghalaya
fields.briefDescription: The aims to award laptops to meritorious students of Board Examination. Through this scheme, laptops are provided to eligible students who meet the published merit criteria.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for the Award of Scholarship for Post Graduate Students of Various Faculties of Junagadh Agricultural University" provides monthly scholarships to students pursuing Post Graduate in various faculties at Junagadh Agricultural University.

fields.schemeName: Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial loan assistance of up to ₹25,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum is provided to Unreserved category candidates for pursuing commercial pilot training.

fields.schemeName: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycle assistance is provided to economically backward class girls studying in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aid schools across Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Uniform Assistance for Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying Standard 1st to 8th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Socially and Educationally Backward Class Students Studying Standard 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, aims to promote educational inclusivity among SEBC students by providing financial assistance of ₹900/- for uniforms.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to Nomadic and De-notified Tribe students for pursuing higher education in self-financed colleges.

fields.schemeName: Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Economically Backward Class for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for backward class students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

fields.schemeName: Tuition Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- annually to unreserved category students in the science stream of Class 11th and 12th.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Assistance for Pre-preparation for Competitive Exams of ALL INDIA level like IIM, CEPT, NIFT, NLU and IELTS, TOFEL, GRE for going Foreign
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to assist SEBC and economically backward students in coaching for premier Indian and international exams, the eligible candidates receive up to ₹20,000/- or the actual fee paid.

fields.schemeName: Mamasaheb Phadke Management of Govt Adarsh ​​Residential Schools (SC) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to expand access to quality residential education for scheduled caste students in standards 9 to 12. Through this scheme, eligible SC students receive free boarding, lodging, textbooks, uniforms, meals, and additional support services to enhance academic participation.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Swami Vivekananda Utkrisht Chhatravriti Yojana” is a Scholarship Scheme by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh. An amount of ₹ 18,000/- per year will be given to the general category students for two successive years after matric. 2000 scholarships are awarded every year.

fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Interest Subsidy Scheme on Education Loan" by the Education Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial support to students by offering 100% interest subsidy on education loans.

fields.schemeName: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to SEBC students.

fields.schemeName: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Lokpal of India Internship Scheme offers students exposure to anti-corruption laws and institutions. Interns learn about governance, legal frameworks, and contribute ideas to enhance transparency and accountability in public administration.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: National Award to Teachers (For Excellence in Vocational Training and Entrepreneurship Development)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to recognize and honor excellence in vocational training and entrepreneurship development by faculty and trainers.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Grant Of Rewards To The Children Of Salt Labourers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scheme for Grant of Rewards to the Children of Salt Labourers” was launched by Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry in the year 1985.

fields.schemeName: Women Scientist Scheme-A
fields.briefDescription: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineering, preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employment, to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession.

fields.schemeName: Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the University Grants Commission for Girl students who are admitted in the first year of PG courses in any designated university or a postgraduate college, and happen to be the only girl child in the family. The amount of fellowship is ₹ 36,200/- per annum.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship To Scheduled Tribe Students Of Nagaland
fields.briefDescription: The Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) has launched the Post Matric Scholarship to ST students of the Nagaland scheme for providing socio-economic welfare to the students belonging to the residentship of Nagaland state. The student must be studying or getting admission to the post-matric class.

fields.schemeName: Special Incentive to ST (P)/OBC/MOBC Meritorious Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial grants to meritorious ST (P)/OBC/MOBC students in Assam who secure high marks in Matriculation, 10+2, Graduation, or Post Graduation. Benefits include fixed monetary assistance ranging from ₹10,000/- to ₹25,000/- based on educational level.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Virasat ka Samvardhan
fields.briefDescription: PM VIKAS is a Central sector scheme that focuses on socio-economic empowerment of six notified minorities in the country through skilling & training, women leadership & empowerment and education. The scheme integrates erstwhile skilling & education schemes of the Ministry of Minority Affairs.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
fields.schemeName: Right To Information Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, DOPT proposes to offer four short-term fellowships to researchers from the field of media / Civil Society professionals / RTI Trainers to conduct field-based research on themes relating to RTI. It is hoped that the research output will enhance their understanding of the RTI Act.

fields.schemeName: Biotechnology Research Innovation And Entrepreneurship Development (Bio-RIDE)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to foster innovation, promote bio-entrepreneurship, and strengthen India's position as a global leader in biomanufacturing and biotechnology. It provides seed funding, extramural grants, and infrastructure support to startups, enterprises, industries, and academia.

fields.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: INSPIRE Fellowship is one of the components of INSPIRE scheme implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India to strengthen the Science and Technology base of the country. This Component focuses on attracting students to pursue doctoral degree.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre Matric SC, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC students of Std. IX–X with UT domicile studying in recognized schools having valid UDISE code. Parent/guardian income must be below ₹2.5 lakh p.a. Assistance: ₹3,500 for day scholars, ₹7,000 for hostellers, plus 10% extra for Divyang students.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeShortTitle: SUPPLY OF STATIONERY, SOCKS, SHOES, SCHOOL BAG
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Stationery, Socks, Shoes, School Bag, etc. to all Students of Std I to VIII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Stationery, Socks, Shoes, School Bag, etc. to all Students of Std. I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Supply of Textbook to all Students for IX to XII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of Textbook to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

fields.schemeName: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma)
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by AICTE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical diploma course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for a period of max. of 3 years for first-year students and a max. of 2 years for second-year admitted students (later entry).

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Top Class Education For Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for Scheduled Caste students pursuing studies beyond class 12th admitted in a full-time course in one of the notified institutions. The total annual family income from all sources must be less than or equal to Rs. 8.00 lakh.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
fields.briefDescription: A fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC) for Single Girl Child for research in Social Sciences with an aim to compensate for direct costs of higher education, especially for such girls who happen to be the only girl child in their family.

fields.schemeName: Post Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme For University Rank Holders At Under-Graduate Level Applicable
fields.briefDescription: UGC, Dept. of Higher Education introduced a Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship Scheme for University rank holders both in General and Honours Courses at the UG level. The scholarship may be tenable for a period of two years.

fields.schemeName: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T. And S.B.C. Girl Students Studying In 5th To 7th Standard
fields.briefDescription: Savitribai Phule Scholarship is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Dept., Govt. of Maharashtra, to encourage the enrollment and to decrease the dropout ratio of Girl Students of Maharashtra from Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes and Special Backward Classes.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship For Cadets Of Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC), Dehradun
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at RIMC, Dehradun, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces. The scheme is 100% funding from the State Plan Fund

fields.schemeName: Bidya Lakshmi Loan
fields.briefDescription: "Bidya Lakshmi" aims to provide education loans for higher studies to children of Assam State Government employees. Benefits include loans up to ₹10,00,000/- at 4% interest, with subsidies for eligible candidates.

fields.schemeName: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: "CMST: Scholarship of Students with Disabilities" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Govt. of Manipur. In this scheme, the Students with Disability who are a domicile of the State of Manipur, and are studying in Class 1st and and above are awarded with scholarship of upto ₹ 8,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Arunachal Pradesh State Stipend Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, provide financial support to scheduled tribe (ST) students pursuing higher and technical education through stipends and book grants.

fields.schemeName: Krushi Mahotsav
fields.briefDescription: The Krishi Mahotsav Yojana is an agricultural development scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat in the year 2010. The scheme aims to boost agricultural productivity and increase the income of farmers in the state.

fields.schemeName: Special Education And Vocational Training Through Government Institutions
fields.briefDescription: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability between the age group of 6 to 18 years in the Government Special Schools and Vocational Training is provided to special children above the age of 18 years. Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible.

fields.schemeName: The Post-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribes Students" by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, and Government of Mizoram aims to provide financial assistance to ST students pursuing post-matriculation education. It covers various recognized courses.

fields.schemeName: Unemployment Allowance
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh Berozgari Bhatta Yojana is an important initiative of Chhattisgarh Government for the unemployed. It has been announced by the Chief Minister of the state Mr. Bhupesh Baghel in his budget speech on 06-03-2023.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance for the physical & psychological rehabilitation of child victims of communal, caste, ethnic & terrorist violence with special reference to their care, education & training, besides promoting communal harmony,

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidhyarti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to cover the tuition fees for meritorious students from Madhya Pradesh admitted to graduate courses. Financial assistance for admission and course fees is provided to eligible students through this scheme.

fields.schemeName: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
fields.briefDescription: In the year 1984, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of the Schedule Tribe.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship To Scheduled Castes Students Studying In Government ITI’s
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scholarship to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Government ITI's” was launched by the Dept. of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana in the year 2017-18. This scheme is implemented through Skill Development and Industrial Training Department, Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Young Interns Program
fields.briefDescription: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government departments.

fields.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Scholarship For Higher Education (SHE)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)" aims to attract students to study basic and natural Science subjects at undergraduate and postgraduate levels and pursue research as a career by providing scholarships to interested and deserving students.

fields.schemeName: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
fields.briefDescription: In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

fields.schemeName: Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, "Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed" scheme is run by the "Tribal Area Development Department" from 2004-05.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Schemes For Sc/st/obc (non-creamy Layer) & Minority Students For Universities
fields.briefDescription: Coaching schemes for students belonging to SC (Scheduled Caste), ST (Scheduled Tribe), OBC (Other Backward Classes) (non-creamy layer), and minority communities are implemented to provide them with equal opportunities and support in pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Internship Policy Of The Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Policy of the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board intends to provide practical training experience (in summer/ winter etc.) to the students studying in various hospitality / tourism-related schools in Madhya Pradesh or outside the state.

fields.schemeName: Internship Policy Of Indian Council For Cultural Relations (ICCR)
fields.briefDescription: ICCR provides an excellent opportunity for budding scholars to familiarise themselves with the role of soft power in foreign policy formulation in the Govt of India. These ‘Interns’ would be expected to supplement the process of analysis in various fields (creative writing, cultural mapping, etc).

fields.schemeName: Internship Programme Of The Department Of Expenditure
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure aims to familiarize willing and eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and Graduates pursuing post-Graduation/ post-Graduates pursuing Research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Govt.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship For Transgender Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scholarship for Transgender Students” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala for providing scholarships to Transgender students from 7th standard onwards studying in State Government/ Government aided/ Self Financing schools.

fields.schemeName: Merit Based Award and Recognition Of High Performance In The Board Exams Of SSC And HSSC In The State Of Goa
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to motivate students by giving Merit Based Award on the benchmark of performance and to provide financial incentives to high-performing students who are economically weak. The scheme aims to increase the representation of the ST Community in the High-Rank Holders.

fields.schemeName: Fee Waiver Scheme For SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education
