fields.briefDescription: "Fee Waiver Scheme for SC/ST Students Pursuing Higher Education" provides free access to every SC/ST student, to the institutions of higher learning so that that no eligible SC/ST students are deprived of higher education for want of resources.

fields.schemeName: Medhavi Chhatr/Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Medhavi Chhatr/ Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" for education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Free Coaching for SCs, OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES Children Scheme
fields.briefDescription: To provide high-quality free coaching to economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and eligible beneficiaries of the PM CARES Children Scheme for competitive exams in public and private sector employment and admission into professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Padho Pardesh
fields.briefDescription: Padho Pardesh is a scheme of interest subsidy on educational loans for overseas studies for the students belonging to the minority communities. The scheme was launched by the Ministry of Minority Affairs in 2006 under the Prime Minister's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of Minorities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A Scheme "Free Coaching for Students with Disabilities" was initiated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the "Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment".

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: FutureSkills Prime Incentive Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote a novel skilling ecosystem in the country, the programme/scheme would incentivize the cost of the eligible course(s) concerned, providing authentic and accredited certifications that are acceptable in the industry.

fields.schemeName: National Scholarship For Post Graduate Studies
fields.briefDescription: A scheme started by Ministry of Education for the student Higher education.

fields.schemeName: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows (for under graduate students)
fields.briefDescription: BIRAC’s E-YUVA Fellows shall apply as a team and pursue their research work at their College/University labs and will also be allowed access to facilities at EYC and EYC Knowledge Partners as and when required.

fields.schemeName: West Bengal Student Credit Card Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal has introduced the Student Credit Card Scheme for the students of West Bengal to enable them to pursue higher education without having any financial constraints.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Aadharbhut Shiksha Prashikshan Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Aadharbhut Shiksha Prashikshan Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 29 March 2023.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides full interest subsidy during the moratorium period on loan availed under Model Education Loan Scheme of Indian Banks’ Association (IBA) to students belonging to economically weaker sections whose annual parental income is up to ₹4.5 Lakhs from all sources.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows
fields.briefDescription: “Reimbursement of Tuition Fees for Typewriting and Shorthand Courses for Children of Widows” by the Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Pondicherry, was introduced to encourage the children of widows to pursue Typewriting and Shorthand courses and facilitate the reimbursement of course fees.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: Cash awards shall be given to the three male & three female children of the registered construction workers in each district to those students who score 75% or above, 65% or less than 75%, and 55% or less than 65% mark in HSLC, AHM and H.S. examinations.

fields.schemeName: Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Government of Puducherry. The objective of the scheme is to benefit the students who are studying at the Post-matric level or Post-Secondary stage to complete their education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Top Class School Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide premium education to the meritorious students belonging to OBC, EBC, and DNT categories by funding their education from Class 9 onwards till they complete Class 12.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Siksha Kaushal Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK SIKSHA KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA (NSKKVY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance for education and skill development to the children of registered construction workers in the state.

fields.schemeName: Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students
fields.briefDescription: The "Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students" initiated by the Department of Information & Publicity, Union Territory of Puducherry, is designed to extend financial assistance to OEBC students, mitigating the risk of dropouts due to financial constraints.

fields.schemeName: Award of Puducherry State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme make sure that no brilliant student is prevented on the grounds of poverty alone from pursuing the academic career. Scholarship is awarded to students in 11th & 12th standards who have secured promotion to the next higher class with 60% & 50% marks in 10th & 11th standard respectively.

fields.schemeName: Award of Scholarship to the Cadets Belonging to UT of Puducherry and Studying in Rashtriya Indian Military College, Dehradun
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to extend scholarships worth of ₹20,000/- per annum to the cadets belonging to the Union Territory of Puducherry who come from economically weak backgrounds and have been selected for admission into the Rashtriya Indian Military College, Dehradun.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: "Grant of Annual Scholarship to the Students Belonging to UT of Puducherry Selected and Studying in the Sainik School, Amaravathi Nagar, Tamil Nadu" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Directorate of School Education, Puducherry. A scholarship of ₹10,000/- per annum per student is provided.

fields.schemeName: "SUPER 30" Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Super 30" was launched by the Directorate of Secondary Education, Tripura. The scheme aims to provide free coaching for JEE/ NEET to the students who are appearing in the class 10th Board Final Exam and want to pursue Science Stream in Class 11th & 12th with the aspiration to crack JEE/NEET.

fields.schemeName: Award of Scholarship to the Children who are Recipients of National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and Other National / International Merit Awards
fields.briefDescription: The objectives of this scheme are to recognize the talents of children who are recipients of the National Child Award for Exceptional Achievements and other National/International Merit Awards and to recognize the talents of children who are pursuing outstanding achievements in different fields.

fields.schemeName: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana (RS-CSEP)
fields.briefDescription: The Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana, offered by the Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL), provides free training in spoken English and personality development for women and girls.

fields.schemeName: Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi
fields.briefDescription: In the "Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi" scheme to encourages girl students to study agriculture subject and provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students who may face challenges in accessing education due to financial constraints.

fields.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA" is a Welfare Scheme by the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund of the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, up to ₹20,000/- is provided to the unemployed Ex-servicemen to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.

fields.schemeName: Award to Scheduled Castes Students Who Secured Top Ranks at State and District Level in Standard X & XII (Sahuji Maharaj Assistance)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, Scheduled Castes Category students who have Secured Top Ranks at State and District Levels in Gujarat in Standard X & XII are given cash prizes. Cash prizes are awarded to the first three students who secure the highest ranks in both Standard X and Standard XII across all streams.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Preparation of Examination Like IIM, NIFT, NLU, CEPT
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Students of the Scheduled Castes category who are preparing for examinations like IIM, NIFT, NLU, and CEPT.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance for Purchase of Textbooks/Notebooks to School-Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees (GLWB)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the children of industrial workers/employees, studying in classes 1st to 4th in recognized/approved schools are provided financial assistance for the purchase of textbooks/notebooks. The scheme aims to provide financial support for the educational needs of the children.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Assistance Scheme for Preparation of Recruitment Exams for Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to Students of SC category who are preparing for all State Government and Central Government Recruitment Examinations of Class– 1, 2 & 3 conducted by UPSC/GPSC/State Commission/Bank/LIC/Subordinate Services Selection Board/District Panchayat Selection Board.

fields.schemeName: Book Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "Book Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows" is a Welfare Scheme by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. Through this scheme, the wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM studying in Government-recognized Institutions are provided allowances towards the purchase of books.

fields.schemeName: Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Uttar Pradesh initiated a scheme "Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana" to encourage the children towards the education.

fields.schemeName: Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Uttar Pradesh initiated a scheme "Ganesh Shankar Vidyarthi Shramik Puraskar Raschi Yojana" to encourage the children towards the education.

fields.schemeName: SC/ST Pre Matric Scholarship - Uttar Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) students. This scholarship aims to financially assist students from these categories to pursue secondary education and complete their matriculation.

fields.schemeName: OBC Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for Other Backward Class (OBC) students. This scholarship aims to financially assist students from these categories to pursue secondary education and complete their matriculation.

fields.schemeName: Alpasankhyak Post-Maitrik Chhaatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Alpasankhyak Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme under the Madhya Pradesh Government is to provide financial assistance to students from minority communities in Madhya Pradesh pursuing post-secondary education.

fields.schemeName: Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons
fields.briefDescription: 'Readers Allowance to Visually Impaired Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide readers allowance to visually impaired students, specific allowance rates based on the education level.

fields.schemeName: AlCTE - Distinguished Professional Scheme
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Distinguished Professionals Scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education, Ministry of Education to improve the quality of Technical Education in India by utilizing the expertise of Professionals, Emeritus professors & Eminent Personalities to share their knowledge.

fields.schemeName: Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired
fields.briefDescription: The "Early Intervention Centre for the Visually Impaired" was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, visually impaired children are identified, assessed and prepared to join main stream education in 6 districts.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship (Above VIII Standard) - Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The 'Scholarship (Above VIII Standard) by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide scholarships to differently-abled students studying in government school/colleges/training centre

fields.schemeName: Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme - Sikkim
fields.briefDescription: The "Comprehensive Educational Loan Scheme" was launched by the Department of Personnel, and Reforms, Training, Public Grievances, Government of Sikkim. The scheme aims to provide loans free of interest for the duration of one particular course of study with one one-year moratorium period offered...

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by Haryana Backward Classes & Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, aims to provide education loans to sections of minority population on the basis of "Creamy Layer". These loans support pursuing general/professional/technical courses at graduate levels or higher.

fields.schemeName: State Award for Teachers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "State Awards to Teachers" aims to celebrate the unique contribution of the finest teachers in the state and honor those who have improved the quality of school education and enriched students' lives. Ten state awards consisting of ₹100,000 and a citation each are provided to teachers.

fields.schemeName: Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
fields.briefDescription: The "Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged" scheme aims to provide motorized three wheelers to orthopedically challenged persons. This initiative ensures that eligible individuals receive support to enhance their mobility and independence.

fields.schemeName: Children With Special Needs Under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan
fields.briefDescription: The "Children With Special Needs (CWSN)" scheme aims to provide comprehensive educational support and resources tailored to the needs of children with disabilities. It is designed to ensure that every child, regardless of their disability type (intellectual, physical, etc.), receives the necessary a

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Fatherless Girls
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education Professional Education Course - Chartered Accountancy Final" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin students.

fields.schemeName: Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence
fields.briefDescription: The "Gayathri Scheme for Academic Excellence" scheme aims to provide awards to the topper of the recognized and reputed School/ College/ Institute for his/her academic excellence in SSC/ Intermediate or equivalent/ Graduation/ Professional Education Course for the Academic year.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Self/ Children of Beneficiaries'' scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, West Bengal, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered member or their children studying Higher Secondary and above.

fields.schemeName: Digital J&K Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Digital J&K Internship Scheme" is an opportunity for the students to secure first-hand and practical work experience. It also aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation and putting into practice the knowledge acquired in the studies.

fields.schemeName: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 1 to 8)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to give benefits for improving the educational status of scheduled tribe students. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 1 to 8.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary (O.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: The “Financial Assistance for the Education of Children of the Beneficiary” scheme by the BOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Odisha, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance for education to the children of the registered member of the board for a period of one year or more.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Meritorious Student Award Scheme
fields.briefDescription: This scheme awards special prizes to meritorious Scheduled Caste students who secure the highest marks in the Class 10th and 12th board examinations conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, CBSE, and ICSE in the state.

fields.schemeName: Overseas Educational Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Overseas Educational Loan Scheme" objective is to provide financial/loan assistance to students belonging to minority communities who are pursuing graduate or postgraduate degree courses in recognized universities abroad.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister EBC Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Bihar Government provides incentives to individuals belonging to the EBC Categories upon passing the preliminary examination of various competitive exams such as UPSC, BPSC, NDA, CDS, Banking, Railway, SSC, etc., to support their further preparation for the main examination/interview.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati Ewam Anusuchit Janjati Civil Sewa Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to SC & ST candidates who qualify in the preliminary examination of Civil Services Competitive Examination conducted by the BPSC, Patna, and the UPSC, New Delhi, to support their preparation for main examination/interview.

fields.schemeName: Free Education Scholarship for Professional Courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, and Law)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides full coverage of tuition fees, special fees, and examination fees for Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) students pursuing professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Awards to Bright Students
fields.briefDescription: The "Awards to Bright Students" scheme offers financial assistance to the top two boys and two girls from Adi Dravidar/Tribal/Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity in each district who have excelled in their 10th standard public examinations and continue their studies.

fields.schemeName: Book Bank Scheme: II
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides free textbooks to Adi Dravidar/Tribal students pursuing professional courses like Medical, Engineering, Law, MBA, and others, which must be returned to the library after course completion.

fields.schemeName: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for SC Students" aims to provide additional financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance. Additional monthly allowances are provided to meet food, travel, and disability-related expenses.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses
fields.briefDescription: The Educational Assistance for Government Recognised Diploma Courses scheme is designed to financially support children of registered construction workers, providing ₹20,000 per year for diploma courses and ₹25,000/- per year for postgraduate diploma courses.

fields.schemeName: Workers for Class 9th to 12th Through National Scholarship (JKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2018, the "Workers for Class 9th to 12th" scheme, under the MUHAFIZ Scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., J&K, provides ₹1,200 per year for up to two children of registered BOC workers through the National Scholarship Portal.

fields.schemeName: Prize Schemes to the Students (State Level Prizes)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme awards students from Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) for their excellent performance in academic exams studying in Government/Government Aided and Private Schools.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girls in Bihar by providing a one-time incentive of ₹25,000/- to eligible graduate students of the state.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Students of Class 11th &12th ( Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1976-77, the "Post Matric Students of Class 11th &12th " scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a facility for the reimbursement of scholarship fees to students.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric College Scholarship (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1976-77, the "Post Matric College Scholarship" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance to encourage Scheduled Caste students to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 1966, the scheme "Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free accommodation and mess facilities to students from studying in Class 9th to 12th in a government/recognized school.

fields.schemeName: Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a financial support initiative by the Jharkhand Government to help students pursue higher education without financial constraints. Under this scheme, eligible students can avail of education loans up to ₹15,00,000 at a subsidized 4% simple interest rate, with additional benefits.

fields.schemeName: Study Abroad Scholarships (Scheduled Tribe)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 2003, the scheme "Study Abroad Scholarships" by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh covers tuition fees of 40,000 US Dollars per year, along with a living allowance of 9,000 US Dollars and a contingency allowance of 1,000 US Dollars.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to promote higher education among scheduled tribe students in Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance to students pursuing professional and academic courses at the post-matriculation level.

fields.schemeName: Junior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 1966, the scheme "Junior Hostel" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free accommodation and mess facilities to students studying in classes 6th to 8th.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" enhances the participation of Scheduled Caste students in pre-matric education and provides them with equal educational opportunities. The scheme aims to encourage students to continue their education and reduce dropout rates.......

fields.schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "M.P. Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward backward-class students who excel in professional entrance examinations. Monetary awards are provided to backward-class students who secure the top three positions in entrance examinations like PET, PPT, and MCA.

fields.schemeName: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Backward Classes Student Merit Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward academic excellence among backward-class students. Monetary awards are provided to one boy and one girl student from backward classes who secure the highest marks at the district level in class 10th and 12th board exams.

fields.schemeName: Admission in Post Matric Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on 1st January1900, the scheme "Admission in Post Matric Hostel" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free accommodation to backward class students to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Nursing Kaushal College Jharkhand
fields.briefDescription: The "Nursing Skill College" scheme provides skill-based nursing education and employment opportunities to young women, especially from disadvantaged backgrounds. The scheme offers free residential training, modern learning facilities, and placement support.

fields.schemeName: Admission in Post Matric Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched on 1st January1900, the scheme "Admission in Post Matric Hostel" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free accommodation to backward class students to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. The selected students receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjects.

fields.schemeName: Haryana State Merit Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support meritorious students from economically backward sections in pursuing higher education. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to students pursuing Degree, Post-Graduate, and Doctorate courses.

fields.schemeName: HSCST Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: In order to attract talented & meritorious students, HSCSIT is offering research fellowships in various fields of Science & Technology & Medical Sciences. The fellowships will involve full time research work leading to Ph.D. degree from any of the Institute/University in Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Foreign Education Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Foreign Education Scheme" provides financial assistance for non-reserved category students pursuing higher education abroad after Standard 12.

fields.schemeName: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The KVPY is a national fellowship program in basic sciences, initiated and funded by the Department of Science and Technology to attract exceptionally motivated students to pursue basic science courses and a research career in science.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Medhwi Balika Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities based on their performance in the High School Examination or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi) and Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim).

fields.schemeName: National Awards to Teachers
fields.briefDescription: "National Awards to Teachers" aims to celebrate the contributions of outstanding teachers and enhance the quality of school education. This award provides public recognition and honours the commitment of teachers, benefiting meritorious teachers working in primary, middle, and secondary schools.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Pichhda Varg Evam Ati Pichhda Varg Kaushal Vikas Prashikshan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve employability through free skill training for youth of backward and extremely backward communities.

fields.schemeName: Anya Pichhda Varg Kalyan Chhatravaas
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme "Anya Pichhda Varg Kalyan Chhatravaas" under the BC & EBC Welfare Department, Bihar. under this scheme, provied ₹1,000/- per month hostel grant is provided for each student and 15 kg of free food grains per month (9 kg rice + 6 kg wheat).

fields.schemeName: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free cycles to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions and belonging to Denotified Tribes, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities of Rajasthan.

fields.schemeName: Financial Incentive to SC Meritorious Girls Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial incentives worth ₹5,000/- to the meritorious girls from Scheduled Castes who have secured 80% or above marks in the HSLC examination. To objective is to motivate and encourage SC students to pursue higher studies and bring them at par with the rest.

fields.schemeName: Rural Technology Complex
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" by the Programme Implementation Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to enhance livelihood opportunities in the Himalayan region through the use of local, need-based and environment-friendly technologies.

fields.schemeName: ICSSR Post-Doctoral Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Postdoctoral Fellowships to encourage original and quality research by young and mid-career scholars in the field of social sciences. It is designed for researchers who have just finished their Ph.D. in advanced social science research.

fields.schemeName: ICSSR Senior Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social scientific Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, offers a Senior Fellowship Scheme designed to assist accomplished Indian researchers in conducting advanced social science research.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Scheduled Tribe (Plains) Students for Coaching for Getting Admission into Medical/Engineering/IIT/etc.
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to ST (P) students for coaching to qualify for Medical, Engineering, and IIT entrance exams. It benefits eligible students by reimbursing coaching expenses, with selection based on merit from matriculation exam scores.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for UPSC/APSC Mains Exam
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to ST and OBC/MOBC students of Assam who have cleared the APSC/UPSC preliminary exam and are appearing for the mains exam in the current year.

fields.schemeName: Freeship Staff Ward
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of students who are wards of university staff and are pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or PhD courses by providing 50% of tuition fee concessions.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
fields.briefDescription: This initiative provides academic fees and maintenance allowances to support students from Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh pursuing higher education outside the Union Territories

fields.schemeName: Gujarat Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Standard 1st to 10th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for educational development to Scheduled Tribe students studying in Classes 1 to 10. Through this scheme, scholarships are annual

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme for Backward Classes Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide education loans to members of the Backwards Classes for pursuing professional and technical education. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of education loans is provided to eligible Backwards Class students.

fields.schemeName: Sainik School Scholarship Located Outside the Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial assistance to students from Uttarakhand enrolled in classes 6 to 12 at Sainik Schools outside the state, with scholarships awarded based on family income.

fields.schemeName: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 6 to 12 by offering free education, accommodation, meals, study materials, sports facilities, and other essential services across all Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya / Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya in the state.

fields.schemeName: Right to Education Act 2009 - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free education, textbooks, uniforms, and the benefits of the PM Poshan Yojana to children up to Class 8 in private schools, targeting rural and urban children from weaker and deprived sections of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Chief Minister Scholarship Scheme" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students for pursuing medical, engineering, diploma, and higher education courses.

fields.schemeName: Namo Saraswati Vignan Sadhana Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Namo Saraswati Vignan Sadhana Yojana (8620)" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to promote science education by providing financial assistance to students enrolling in the science stream in Class 11th and 12th.

fields.schemeName: Orientation Courses in Dramatics
fields.briefDescription: The "Orientation Courses in Dramatics" scheme by the Tiatr Academy of Goa aims to improve the quality of tiatr performances. It offers preliminary training and workshops in various aspects of dramatics, such as script writing and acting, to individuals and existing tiatr artistes.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekanand Scholarship for Technical Diploma in Professional Courses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support ST students enrolled in ITIs and recognized training institutes by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400 for a duration of 12 months.

fields.schemeName: Educational Travel Promotion Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Educational Travel Promotion Scheme" by the Department of Education, aims to promote personality development, observation skills, and curiosity among students through funding educational tours.

fields.schemeName: Samriddhi – Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Students for Setting Start-Ups
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide opportunities for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe students to design, launch, and run their own business or startup after formal education is completed or during their final year of education. The scheme provides a limited one-time financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Akhil Bhartiya Veda Sammelan and Akhil Bhartiya Jyotish Vastu Sammelan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a platform for scholars engaged in the study, teaching, propagation, and research of Vedas, Astrology, and Vastu Shastra to participate in the conference.

fields.schemeName: CM-Vashistha Guru Puraskar
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the state and to honour those teachers who through their commitment and industry have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students.

fields.schemeName: S.T. Bus Pass Fee Concession Scheme For Government/ Non Government Primary, Secondary & Higher Secondary and Higher Technical Education Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide concession in bus fare fees to the students studying in Primary, Secondary, Higher Secondary, and Higher Secondary Technical Education in Government and Non-Government schools. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC).

fields.schemeName: Organization of Various Conclaves and Felicitations to Encourage Women, Women Scientists, Teachers and Young Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote and enhance scientific attitude and skill development of women, women scientists, teachers, and young students of the state by organizing conclaves and felicitating them.

fields.schemeName: Police Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to familiarize meritorious students with police functioning and promote research in law enforcement by providing selected students a six-week internship in district police stations under official supervision.

fields.schemeName: Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the quality of teaching in schools in the State of Goa by equipping teachers with necessary Information Technology knowledge and skills. It offers an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for purchasing a Laptop to regular/permanent, full-time teachers.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric & Post-Matric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide stipend and financial assistance to students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. The benefits include financial assistance and stipends for poor students from Class 9th up to normal Three Years Degree Courses (e.g. Bachelor of Arts, Bachelor of Science, etc.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Higher Studies
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for students belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community. This assistance supports students pursuing higher education like MBBS, MBA, and Engineering, including studies within and outside the State or Country.

fields.schemeName: Coaching For Higher Studies
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide coaching to students of Tea Tribes and Adivasi community for preparing them for various competitive examinations like Civil Services, Medical, Engineering, Staff Selection Committee (Graduate level), Banking (Probationary Officers), etc.

fields.schemeName: The Goa Archaeological Research Fellowship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage scholars to undertake research activities in the field of Archaeology of Goa and West Coast based on primary archaeological sources. It offers financial fellowship assistance of up to ₹40,000/- per month to eligible Post-Graduate or PhD scholars for 24 months.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Y.V. Singh Award for Best Thesis in Vegetable Science
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage students for their outstanding research work in the field of Vegetable Science. Under this, a cash award of ₹20,000/- is provided annually to the selected students.

fields.schemeName: Asian Agri-History Foundation Research Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture - All Disciplines)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture across all disciplines by awarding a monthly fellowship of ₹1,200/- for one year.

fields.schemeName: Free Shoe and Bag Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in all government & government-aided schools for purchasing shoes & bags. An amount of ₹318/- per student for Classes 1 to 5 & ₹462/- per student for Classes 6 to 8 is provided through Direct Benefit Transfer.

fields.schemeName: RIMC Scholarship (Military Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month to students from Uttarakhand who are pursuing their education at the Rashtriya Indian Military College (RIMC).

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Providing Soft Skill Training Courses to Students Studying in State Colleges
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the soft skills of students studying in state colleges of Uttarakhand by providing training through Mahindra Pride Classroom and the Nandi Foundation.

fields.schemeName: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Pragati Scholarship (81 for Uttarakhand girl students (Diploma) and 50 for Graduation)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girl students of the state by providing financial assistance in the form of scholarship. Under this scheme, scholarships are awarded to 81 girl students enrolled in Diploma courses and 50 girl students enrolled in Graduation courses in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Dr. K.C. Sharma Fellowship (M.Sc. Agriculture, Agronomy (Second Year) Students)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agriculture (Agronomy) who are in their second year of study, by awarding them a monthly fellowship of ₹1000/- for one year.

fields.schemeName: Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Maharishi Balmiki Chatravriti Yojana” by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Himachal Pradesh is a Scholarship Scheme for female students belonging to the Balmiki family. The beneficiary receives ₹ 18,000 per annum for college-level studies and professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mukhiya Mantri Protsahan Yojna” was launched by Dept. of Higher Education, H.P. during the year 2013-14. Under the scheme, an Incentive/Award will be given to students of the State who are selected and take admission for a degree course in any IIT/AIIMS/IIM/ISM Dhanbad/IISc Bangalore.

fields.schemeName: Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra Scholarship Scheme” was started by the Department of Education, Himachal Pradesh. Under the scheme, scholarship is given to the students of Himachal Pradesh who are studying in Sainik School Sujanpur Tihra.

fields.schemeName: Indira Gandhi Utkrisht Chattervriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: A merit-based scholarship scheme of ₹18,000 per annum by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Himachal Pradesh will be awarded to 10 toppers each from Class 12 (Arts, Science, and Commerce) and from the merit list of B.A., B.Sc. and B.Com

fields.schemeName: State Technical Scholarship for ST Student
fields.briefDescription: The financial assistance is provided to students of Scheduled Tribe Communities who are pursuing Diploma/ Degree/Post Graduated/course in Engineering Institutes recognized by All India Council for Technical Education and, also provided to students who are pursuing UG or PG in Forestry courses.

fields.schemeName: Free Studentship
fields.briefDescription: The "Free Studentship" initiative, administered by the Directorate of Higher & Technical Education, Meghalaya, is a state-sponsored program aimed at providing financial assistance to students belonging to the SC/ST/OBC categories for their tuition fees and other fee according to prescribed rates.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship For Differently Abled Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scholarship for Differently Abled Students” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Pathani Samanta Mathematics Talent (Class - 11 To 12)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School Students of Odisha having proficiency in Mathematics.

fields.schemeName: Vidyakiranam Scheme-Educational Assistance To Children Of Disabled Parents
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Vidyakiranam Scheme-Educational Assistance to Children of Disabled Parents” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Junior Merit (Class - 11 To 12)
fields.briefDescription: The Department of School & Mass Education, Government of Odisha is awarding "Junior Merit Scholarship" under the Scheme 'e-medhabruti’ to provide financial assistance to the meritorious Higher Secondary School students of Odisha from families whose parental income does not exceed 6.00 lakhs.

fields.schemeName: Vikramaditya Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh has created this new scholarship scheme available for candidates belonging to the General categories.

fields.schemeName: Varnam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Varnam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Distance Education Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala to provide financial assistance to Transgender students pursuing Degree/Diploma/ PG courses through distance education.

fields.schemeName: Shikshashree Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Shikshashree Scheme” was implemented by the Government of West Bengal during the year 2014-15  by merging the existing schemes of Book Grants & Maintenance Grants to provide financial assistance to Schedule Caste students studying in classes V to VIII.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Merit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to permanent residents of Mizoram States securing 60% marks in Board/University Examination. The scheme is 100% funded by the State Plan Fund.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Grant of Additional Scholarship to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Tribes of Andaman and Nicobar Islands for Pursuing Higher Studies Anywhere in India Post-Senior Secondary Courses (Post 10+2 Courses)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide additional financial assistance (scholarship) to the ST students pursuing higher education after Senior Secondary i.e. 12th Standard in the Colleges/Universities anywhere in India, as an incentive to supplement the cost of their education.

fields.schemeName: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship For Minority
fields.briefDescription: Launched in June 2006 under the Prime Minister's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of Minorities, the "Post-Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to the Minority Communities" by the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India, aims to provide better opportunities for higher education.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme - Delhi
fields.briefDescription: "Education Loan Scheme" provides financial assistance to the SC/ST/OBC/PwD students for pursuing professional and technical education in India and abroad, with loan limits of ₹7,50,000/- and ₹15,00,000/- respectively. Delhi residents with an annual family income below ₹5,00,000/- are eligible.

fields.schemeName: Higher Education And Skill Development Guarantee Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Higher Education and Skill Development Guarantee Scheme Government of NCT of Delhi , has envisaged a Higher Education and Skill Development Guarantee Scheme for students who wish to pursue diploma or degree level courses or specified skill development courses in Delhi.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship/Merit scholarship to OBC/MIN/SC/ST students from Class I to XII
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from SC/ST/OBC/Minority communities studying in classes I to XII in government or recognised schools in Delhi. The scheme offers varying scholarship amounts based on class and academic performance, ensuring support for education.

fields.schemeName: UGC-BSR Faculty Fellowship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to strengthen basic science research by allowing talented professors nearing superannuation to continue research and mentor Ph.D. students. It provides a monthly fellowship and an annual research grant for 3 years.

fields.schemeName: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue their education at secondary stage.

fields.schemeName: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP): Scholarship Component
fields.briefDescription: The scheme targets the children of these weavers, offering financial assistance of up to ₹2,00,000/- annually. This support covers tuition, admission, and examination fees at recognised textile institutions. Additionally, beneficiaries receive a monthly stipend of ₹5,000/-.

fields.schemeName: Skill Development and Training of Candidates in Technical Textiles
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to train skilled professionals for the technical textiles industry, develop transferable skills, create a strong knowledge ecosystem, integrate trained individuals into various roles, and promote continuous learning and innovation.

fields.schemeName: The CM IT Fellowship Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to empower young professionals with technical expertise to address state-level governance challenges through technology. It offers a 2-year M.Tech program in DSAI, hands-on government project experience, and a monthly stipend of ₹50,000/- to eligible youth of Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister's Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial support is provided to students from Class XI to Ph.D. level. It offers a fixed annual scholarship of ₹6,000 for post-matric studies, which is paid directly into the students’ bank accounts. This scholarship is often provided in addition to other scholarships.

fields.schemeName: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The benefit of Gargi Puraskar Yojana is given every year to the beneficiary girl child of Rajasthan on the day of Basant Panchami. This time also the beneficiary girl students were taken on a tour of the girl students on the occasion of Basant Panchami very year.

fields.schemeName: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Socially and Educationally Backward Girls studying in Class 9th
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycle assistance is provided to Socially and Educationally Backward class girls studying in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aid schools across Gujarat.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Ph.D. Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) students pursuing M.Phil. or Ph.D. to encourage higher education and research.

fields.schemeName: Uniform Assistance for Economically Backward Class Students Studying in Class 1st to 8th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Economically Backward Class Students Studying in Class 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides ₹900/- for three pairs of uniforms to students from economically weaker sections in government and aided primary schools.

fields.schemeName: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Educationally Backward Class (EBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to EBC students.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships of ₹3,000, ₹2,000, and ₹1,000 are provided annually to Science, Commerce, and Arts students to promote higher education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Technical Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide practical technical experience through live projects. Under this programme, a 6-month internship with a stipend of ₹20,000/- per month is offered to eligible engineering students.

fields.schemeName: National Awards To Teachers (Higher Education)
fields.briefDescription: The purpose of National Awards to Teachers is to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the country and to honor those teachers who through their commitment and industry have not only improved the quality of school education but also enriched the lives of their students.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Top Class Education For Students With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by DoEPwDs for Students with Disabilities (SwDs) pursuing studies beyond class 12th admitted in a full-time course in one of the 'notified institutions'.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free residential education to students from Special Backward Classes. Under this scheme, selected students receive free education, accommodation, meals, uniforms, books, and study materials in government-approved schools.

fields.schemeName: A Scheme to Provide Free Tablets to Std.12th Pass Students
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, students in the 12th standard belonging to the Scheduled Caste category will receive a tablet by paying a token fee of ₹1,000/-.

fields.schemeName: IELTS & TOEFL Training Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help tribal students pursue higher studies abroad by offering professional IELTS/TOEFL training. It provides ₹3,10,000/- in training assistance and comprehensive guidance.

fields.schemeName: Nagaland State Merit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The Directorate of Higher Education has launched the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship for the students of classes from 11th to 12th and UG Degree to PG degree so that they will be able to secure their scholarship rights or seats after getting online registration under this scholarship.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes candidates for study at Bachelor Degree programme in various branches of Agriculture, viz. B.Sc. (Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc. (Agril. Engg.), B.Sc. (Home Science), B.F.Sc., B.Sc. (Forestry) etc.

fields.schemeName: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of ESM
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows of ex-servicemen to help them become self-reliant through vocational training.

fields.schemeName: The Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The purpose of this scheme is to provide with Selected Candidates” short term exposure to different verticals/ divisions/ units of IWAI as “Interns”. An intern may be required to work at Head Office or Project Office depending upon the requirement of the Authority.

fields.schemeName: Travel Grant Scheme for College Teachers/Vice Chancellors/Commission Members
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is for providing financial assistance to permanent teachers of colleges & vice-chancellors of state universities, deemed to be universities & central universities, recognised under section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act, to present research papers at international conferences abroad.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe children in classes 9th and 10th to minimize drop-out rates and aid progression to higher education. The scheme provides a recurring monthly scholarship, an annual book grant, and disability allowances directly to the Scheduled Tribe student beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Award Of Scholarships To Young Artists In Different Cultural Fields
fields.briefDescription: This Scheme seeks to give assistance to young artistes of outstanding promise for advanced training within India in the field of Indian Classical Music, Indian Classical Dance, Theatre, Mime, Visual art, Folk, Traditional and Indigenous Arts and Light Classical Music.

fields.schemeName: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
fields.briefDescription: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.

fields.schemeName: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times.

fields.schemeName: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Program
fields.briefDescription: Begum Hazrat Mahal National scholarship is a scholarship scheme also known as Maulana Azad National scholarship scheme was first announced on 3rd May 2003. It is a national level scholarship started for the benefit of the girl’s student belonging to the minority communities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by MoSJE for regular, full-time students from Scheduled Castes, Denotified Nomadic and Semi Nomadic Tribes, Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans; to obtain higher education viz., Master degree or Ph.D courses by studying abroad

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
fields.schemeName: Domestic Funding Of Foreign Training
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Domestic Funding of Foreign Training (DFFT)" is a scheme introduced by the Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India in the year 2001-02 with an objective to upgrade the knowledge & skills of Government officers.

fields.schemeName: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)” aims to build scientific capacity, retain and promote women researchers in India & Germany by utilizing complementary expertise in science, technology, innovation and research partnerships.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme Of The Department Of Economic Affairs
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Scheme aims to familiarise students with macro-economic policy formulation and economic research. Through this scheme, internship opportunities with token remuneration are provided to eligible Post Graduate and PhD students.

fields.schemeName: Mass Communication Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The Mass Communication Internship Programme by the Department of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation. The intern program will offer work culture and environment knowledge about the functioning of the Government and its departments in information, education, and communication.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage higher technical and professional education for dependent wards and widows of CAPFs/Assam Rifles personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. Through this scheme, Financial support per year for girls and boys is provided.

fields.schemeName: Vice Chancellor Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Vice Chancellor Internship Scheme (VCIS) by the University of Delhi aims to provide students with experiential learning opportunities, integrating academic knowledge with practical work experience. This initiative aligns with the objectives of "Samagra Shiksha" (holistic education) as outlined..

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: "Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship" started by the Higher Education Department of West Bengal State for the financial assistance to the student.
