fields.schemeName: Supply of School Uniform , Shoes Socks to all Students for Std IX to XII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Uniform, Shoes Socks to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education to the Wards of  Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers – Pre & Post-Matric
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Ministry of Labour and Employment wherein financial assistance for education is provided to the Wards of Beedi/IOMC/LSDM Workers, varying from ₹1,000/- to ₹25,000/- per student per annum. The benefits are transferred through the DBT system.

fields.schemeName: Summer Internship Programme (PRL)
fields.briefDescription: The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) Summer Internship Programme aims to provide a platform for highly motivated students & teachers to interact with PRL’s scientists, gaining exposure to the lab’s research areas and facilities. Participants will work on projects in fundamental science, technology

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Top Class Education for students with Disabilities, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities, DNH & DD offers tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹1.9 lakh, maintenance allowance, book grant, laptop support, assistive devices, and special disability allowances for eligible UG/PG students in notified institutes. Income limit: ₹8 lakh p.a.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeShortTitle: SS-DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN & DIU
fields.schemeName: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has successfully launched the "Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0" scheme to provide nutritional support for children below 6 years of age, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), and Adolescent Girls (14-18 years).

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students - DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC & DNT students of UT domicile with parental income below ₹2.5 lakh p.a. Academic allowance ₹5,000–₹20,000 p.a. for eligible courses. Online/correspondence students get tuition fees only. Institutes must have AISHE/UDISE code and NAAC/NBA accreditation.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Centrally-Sponsored Scheme Of Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment for regular, full-time students from Scheduled Castes studying in Class 9th and 10th in a Govt. School / a School recognized by Govt. / CBSE / State Board of Secondary Education.

fields.schemeName: National Fellowship For OBC Students
fields.briefDescription: "National Fellowship for OBC Students" was launched by the University Grants Commission (UGC) during the financial year 2014-15 to increase the opportunities for the students of Other Backward Classes (OBCs) to pursue higher education leading to acquiring degrees such as M.Phil. and Ph.D.

fields.schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Junior Research Fellowship in Engineering & Technology" by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education is meant for candidates who wish to pursue research leading to a Ph.D. degree in engineering and technology.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: National Talent Scholarship Postgraduate
fields.briefDescription: Merit based support through National Talent Scholarship to the Under-graduates and Post graduate students seeking admission in Agricultural Universities in a State other than the State of their domicile, through ICAR All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).

fields.schemeName: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship" is a fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education (DoHE). Post-doctoral research is an important enabling step in grooming young researchers for launching an academic/research career.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Swanath Scholarship Scheme For Students
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Student Development Cell (StDC) of All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to provide encouragement and support to orphans, wards of parents who died due to Covid-19, wards of Armed Forces, and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action (Shaheed).

fields.schemeName: Super IAS 500 Scholarship Manipur
fields.briefDescription: The Super IAS 500 Scholarship is a state government initiative in Manipur to provide coaching and financial support to meritorious and brilliant IAS aspirants in the state, with the aim of making Civil Services training more accessible and affordable.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Indian Agricultural Research Institute - Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) Junior and Senior Scholarship shall be awarded to M.Sc. and Ph.D. students admitted under General Open Competition Scheme.

fields.schemeName: State Merit Scholarship Manipur
fields.briefDescription: The Directorate of University & Higher Education, Manipur is interested in awarding State Merit Scholarships to meritorious students of Manipur through online application submissions to promote higher education for economically weaker students in the state.

fields.schemeName: Stipend To Law Graduates
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Social Welfare Department, Govt of Karnataka will give a stipend to the Law Graduates belonging to SC/ST Community residing in Karnataka. This will help them to practice law in various courts and training courses will also be organized under the guidance of senior advocates.

fields.schemeName: Competitive Exam Coaching
fields.briefDescription: Competitive exam Coaching for tribal students scheme was launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development Department in the year 2016-17, under which free coaching to tribal students for competitive examinations through Mankyi Lal Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Udaipur is provided.

fields.schemeName: Prabhuddha Overseas Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The PRABHUDDHA OVERSEAS SCHOLARSHIP scheme selects around 250 undergraduate and 150 postgraduate and PhD students from the SC/ST communities, providing them with financial assistance. The initiative aims to support deserving students in pursuing their academic aspirations.

fields.schemeName: NEET/JEE Coaching For Tribal Students
fields.briefDescription: NEET/JEE Coaching for tribal students scheme launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development in the year 2001.

fields.schemeName: Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Medhavi Putra/Putri Chhatravritti Yojana" is a Scholarship Scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme.

fields.schemeName: Scholarships For Higher Education Abroad To Meritorious Boys And Girls From Open Category
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scholarships for Higher Education Abroad to Meritorious Boys and Girls from open category” was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Maharashtra on 4th October 2018.

fields.schemeName: CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide free coaching to students from economically weaker sections (EWS) and socially backward communities for various competitive exams such as IAS, RAS, and other government job recruitment exams.

fields.schemeName: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
fields.briefDescription: INSPIRE INTERNSHIP aims to provide exposure to the top 1% of students at the Class X Board level by organizing Science Camps either during summer or winter which provides an opportunity for them to interact with Science icons from India and abroad, including Nobel Laureates.

fields.schemeName: Gaon Ki Beti
fields.briefDescription: MP Gaon Ki Beti Yojna 2022-23 is a scholarship provided by the Madhya Pradesh government. The MP state government has started this scheme to encourage the higher education of girl children in remote areas in 2005.

fields.schemeName: Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra has introduced a scheme "Opening And Maintenance Of Public School (Vidya Niketan) For Vimukta Jatis And Nomadic Tribes" to voluntary organizations to run the Public School (Vidya Niketan) on a grant-in-aid basis.

fields.schemeName: Post Metric Scholarship For OBC Students
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Other Backward Classes students studying at the post-matriculation stage to enable students to complete their education.

fields.schemeName: Computer Training Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is being operated with the objective to provide better chances of employment to the youth by enhancing their skills.

fields.schemeName: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
fields.briefDescription: In order to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan to study in top foreign universities of the world. The scheme commenced from 5th October 2021.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme By The Unique Identification Authority Of India (UIDAI)
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Scheme by the UIDAI enables the students to gain adequate exposure to various Technology tracks and other units within UIDAI Headquarters, Technology Centre and Regional offices. It would be expected to work in the field of application development, legal domains (cyber laws/IT) etc.

fields.schemeName: SEBI ITD Internship Program
fields.briefDescription: The SEBI ITD Internship Program provides hands-on training to the students of the institutes based in and around Mumbai. The program accepts up to 15 interns. The Interns accepted under this program would be given an opportunity to work on different Information Technology (IT) projects.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In Rajasthan, the Post-matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of students.

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Sahariya tribal girls' higher education (Class 11 and 12).

fields.schemeName: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.

fields.schemeName: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme” was launched by the Department of Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Government of Tamil Nadu.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s College Students Rehabilitation Scheme (CMCSRS)
fields.briefDescription: CMCSRS aims at providing the required educational facilities to the displaced and affected undergraduate students because of the prevailing social unrest in the state. This scheme is initiated to enable such students to continue with their education without interruption.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme For Students Of Counselling/ Psychology/ Social Work/ Home Science Etc
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to offer aspiring postgraduate students an opportunity for internship facilities to be trained as qualified interns in state-run private children's and shelter homes who can be offered hands-on job training experience.

fields.schemeName: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme For Higher Education For Orphans
fields.briefDescription: "Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme for Higher Education for Orphans" supports the educational needs of orphan children who are deprived of higher education for want of financial resources. The Scheme envisages taking care of such children from their Undergraduate Course to the Post Graduate Course.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Career Advancement in Biotechnology
fields.briefDescription: The programme “Chief Minister’s Career Advancement in Biotechnology (CM-CAB)” aims at providing opportunities to Young Faculty and Scientists in Biotechnology to have national and/or international collaborative research training and exposure to advanced techniques and technologies in biotechnology.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to ST Students under "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana"
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana", financial assistance of upto ₹ 15,000/- is provided to the Scheduled Tribe Students as the maintenance allowance given under the Post Matric Scholarship is inadequate to meet the expenses on food & travel.

fields.schemeName: Advocate Grant
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme “Advocate Grant” was launched by the Backward Classes Development Department, Government of Kerala during the year 2012-13. Under the scheme, the grant will be provided to law graduates belonging to backward classes facing financial difficulties for starting practice as advocates.

fields.schemeName: Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Asangathit Karmakar Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhatravriti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 10 April 2018

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities” was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Telangana in the year 2015-16 for students belonging to the Minority community to pursue Higher Studies in Post Graduate Courses in Foreign Universities.

fields.schemeName: Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Lakshadweep Scholarship Scheme is a government initiative aimed at providing financial assistance to students from Lakshadweep pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Vishesh Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 10 July 2018.

fields.schemeName: Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi for BC and EBC Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mahatma Jyothiba Phule Overseas Vidya Nidhi” was launched by the Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Telangana for meritorious students belonging to Backward Classes & Economically Backward Classes to pursue Higher Studies in foreign universities.

fields.schemeName: Atal Awasiya Vidyala Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Atal Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana is an initiative launched by the Uttar Pradesh government to provide free education to children of construction workers employed in the informal sector.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance (A.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: The “Educational Assistance” scheme was started by the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Welfare Department, Government of Assam to provide educational assistance to the children of the registered construction workers who are studying in Class I to Post Graduate.

fields.schemeName: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: "Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Award to Scheduled Caste Students” was introduced by the Adi Dravidar Welfare Dept, Govt of Puducherry, is granted to top ranking boy and girl student in each region (Pondicherry, Karaikal and Yanam) who have secured 55% marks in the Higher Secondary Examination.

fields.schemeName: Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Award of Scholarship to Differently Abled Person Students” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry is introduced to provide scholarship to the differently abled students, studying from Class 1st upto Postgraduate/ Professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Government Special School for the Visually Handicapped and the Hearing Impaired” by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Puducherry, was introduced to facilitate the education and self-confidence development of visually impaired and hearing-impaired children.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Cash Award to Top Ranking Holders in Public Examinations" scheme, cash awards of ₹50,000/-, ₹30,000/- and ₹20,000/- are granted to the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Rank Holders respectively from SSLC/ SSC/ HSC Exam, and Intermediate (2nd Year) Public Examinations.

fields.schemeName: Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education
fields.briefDescription: "Award of Attendance Scholarship to Girl Students in the Middle Stage of Education" was launched by the Directorate of School Education, UT of Puducherry aims to raise the enrolment of girls in schools in the age group of 11-14 years in the middle stage of education, and to avoid dropout.

fields.schemeName: Dulari Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The DULARI Scheme was implemented by the Directorate of Health Services in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands to provide incentives for newborn baby girls and to the girl children who pass Classes VIII, X, and XII.

fields.schemeName: Riyaayati Dar Par Copies Ka Vitaran
fields.briefDescription: The Labor department of Madhya Pradesh state started the scheme "Riyaayati dar par Copies Ka Vitaran" for the children of construction worker.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award (MBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, the Board annually awards cash prizes to three male and three female children of registered construction workers in each district who scores the highest marks in the SSLC examination.

fields.schemeName: Higher Educational Finance Assistance Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The "Higher Educational Finance Assistance" is a Welfare Scheme by the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Through this scheme, financial assistance is extended to the wards of the Construction Workers who get admission into higher education programs.

fields.schemeName: Cash Benefit Scheme Scheme (PBAOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the "Cash Benefit Scheme" is to provide educational financial assistance to the wards of construction workers who have secured the top three ranks at the State Level and Regional Level in the Higher Secondary course or its equivalent examinations. The amount is credited through DBT.

fields.schemeName: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (General Stream) and have obtained 75% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching fees, as per merit prepared at state level up to 100 students.

fields.schemeName: Cash Incentive to Wards of ESM (Academic Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the academically meritorious wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM pursuing higher education are provided cash incentive of ₹1,000 per month. The application should be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the result of the respective exam.

fields.schemeName: Uniform Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "Uniform Allowance to the Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Widows (Sainik Welfare)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM studying in Government-recognized Institutions are provided allowances towards purchase of their uniform.

fields.schemeName: Fellowship Scheme for M.Phil & Ph.D for Scheduled Caste Students (Maharaja Sayajirao Gayakvad Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. programs at any recognized universities will receive a monthly fellowship.

fields.schemeName: Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "Grant to Meritorious Wards of ESM in Sports: National / International Level" is a Welfare Scheme by the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry. The meritorious wards of the ESM are provided grants for their achievements in sports at national and international levels. The application is offline.

fields.schemeName: General Pre Matric Scholarship-Uttar Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Social Welfare Department offers a Pre Matric Scholarship for General category students. This scholarship aims to financially assist students from these categories to pursue secondary education and complete their matriculation.

fields.schemeName: Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows
fields.briefDescription: The Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme Department, Government of Tamil Nadu launched the "Free Supply of Note Books to the Children of Poor Widows" scheme to supply notebooks to children of poor widows studying up to higher secondary courses and govt. children homes and service homes.

fields.schemeName: Out of School Children scheme under Goa Sarva Shiksha Abhivan
fields.briefDescription: The "Out of School Children" scheme is designed to ensure that every child in the 6-14 age group receives a complete elementary education. The primary objective is to identify children who are out of school and to reintegrate them into the educational system through specialized training programs.

fields.schemeName: Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to motivate students from marginalized sections of society, whose parents are involved in unclean & hazardous occupations, to pursue their education. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,850/- per annum is provided to students from Class 1 to Class 10.

fields.schemeName: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Classes 6 to 8 in government schools. Students whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category are eligible for the benefits.

fields.schemeName: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh to ensure continuity of education for girl students who are the only daughters of their parents. Under this scheme, eligible girl students who are only child of their parents receive a scholarship of ₹5,000/- per year.

fields.schemeName: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to ensure the continuity of education for students from the Backward Classes. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students studying in Classes 6 to 10.

fields.schemeName: Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was implemented by Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide incentives to disabled students. This scheme benefits students pursuing computer/management courses at government colleges, provided their annual parental/guardian income does not exceed ₹1.00 lakh.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Comptroller And Auditor General Of India
fields.schemeName: International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED)
fields.briefDescription: The "International Centre for Environment Audit and Sustainable Development (iCED)" scheme provides a platform to young students pursuing courses in Ocean Science, Environmental Science, Environment Management, Environment Audit, etc. to help develop awareness about the work of iCED with special.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. This scheme aims to enhance educational levels and provide scholarship to children from low-income families.

fields.schemeName: One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students
fields.briefDescription: The "One Time Financial Support for Economically Weaker Meritorious ST Students" scheme aims to provide financial assistance ₹1,00,000/- to the economically weaker meritorious schedule tribe students to pursue different professional & other courses in government-recognized institutes/colleges.

fields.schemeName: Arivu Education Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Arivu Education Loan Scheme," launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation, offers loans to students pursuing professional courses like MBBS, B.E., B.Tech., MBA, MCA, LLB, and others in various fields

fields.schemeName: Bihar State Alpsankhyak Awasiya Vidyalaya Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide quality education to meritorious students from minority communities in the state and to make them mentally, physically, socially, and emotionally capable, fostering their all-round development in residential schools.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Free Education upto 12th Std. to All
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free education for Adi Dravidar, Tribal and Adi Dravidar (Converted to Christianity) students up to 12th standard, covering tuition fees, which are reimbursed by the government.

fields.schemeName: Admission of Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students in Plus One at Reputed Schools
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides education benefits by admitting top Adi Dravidar/Tribal Students into reputed private schools for Plus One, covering 320 students annually across districts.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Stationary-Text Books
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free textbooks to students from 1st to 12th standard in Adi Dravidar and Tribal welfare schools.

fields.schemeName: Pre Examination Training Centre For All India Service Examinations Like I.A.S., I.P.S., I.R.S., Etc.
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free pre-examination training, boarding, and lodging for Adi Dravidar and Tribal community candidates preparing for All India Service Examinations like IAS, IPS, and IRS.

fields.schemeName: Free Education Scholarship for Three-Year Diploma (Polytechnic Courses)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides free education scholarships for students from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities pursuing 3-year Diploma courses in Government and Government-Aided Polytechnics.

fields.schemeName: Free Education Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial support to Backward, Most Backward Classes, and Denotified Communities students pursuing 3-year undergraduate courses (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com.) in Government and Government Aided Arts and Science Colleges.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard
fields.briefDescription: The "Educational Assistance" scheme provides financial support of ₹10,000 per year to children of registered construction workers who are studying in the 11th or 12th standard. The benefit applies to a maximum of two children per worker and extends to the wife of a registered male worker.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance for Degree Course
fields.briefDescription: The Educational Assistance for Degree Course scheme provides financial assistance to children of registered construction workers pursuing their undergraduate degree (1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th year, if applicable). This benefit is also extended to the wife of a registered male worker.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students
fields.briefDescription: The Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses
fields.briefDescription: The Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides educational assistance to the children and spouses of registered construction workers pursuing medical and engineering degrees.

fields.schemeName: Rural Girls’ Incentive Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme provides financial support to girls students of Most Backward Classes (MBC) and Denotified Communities (DNC) studying in rural government or government-aided schools, aimed at encouraging education and reducing school dropouts.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for Class 11th 12th And College
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship" started in 1945 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Madhya Pradesh, provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 11th, 12th, Colleges, PhD, and Professional Courses.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Hostel Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Integrated Hostel Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free residential facilities, meals, and basic amenities to SC/ST/OBC students studying in classes 1st to 12th and also to the students pursuing college education.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to promote higher education among OBC students in Jharkhand. The scheme provides financial assistance to students pursuing professional and academic courses at the post-matriculation level.

fields.schemeName: Free Distribution of Text Books to Students
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st January 2008, the scheme "Free Distribution of Textbooks to Students" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools.

fields.schemeName: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
fields.briefDescription: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Madhya Pradesh Government encourages girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to study. Girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time receive ₹3,000/-

fields.schemeName: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
fields.briefDescription: The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides a scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls for 10 months.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of Fees of ST Students Studying in Sainik School Private Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The "Reimbursement of Fees for ST Students" scheme by the Tribal Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh, offers free accommodation, school fees, and education for eligible students in Sainik Schools and private institutions.

fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
fields.briefDescription: The Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides aid to 20 students yearly with family income under ₹8 lakh, 75% in postgraduation, and teaching experience or an M.Phil degree.

fields.schemeName: Primary Education Scholarship (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: The "Primary Education Scholarship" scheme provides ₹150/- annually to students from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities who are studying in classes 1st to 5th.  The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Prak Pariksha Prashikshan Kendra
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides free pre-examination training to eligible candidates for various competitive exams to enhance their preparation and improve their chances of success.

fields.schemeName: Incentive Scheme in Civil Service (Chhattisgarh)
fields.briefDescription: "Incentive Scheme in Civil Service"  aims to encourage bright and meritorious persons with disabilities to pass competitive exams in the field of civil services. Financial support is provided on passing the different stages of the Union/Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission Competitive Exams.

fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC  and DNT Students for studying in India
fields.briefDescription: "Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC  and DNT Students for studying in India" aims at providing financial assistance to OBC, EWS and DNT students to support their education. The scholarship covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other academic expenses.

fields.schemeName: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme

fields.schemeName: Jan Nayak Pustakalaya evam Digital Adhyan Kendra

fields.schemeName: National Talent Scholarship Undergraduate
fields.briefDescription: National Talent Scholarship (NTS) was launched by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research for students pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in an ICAR-recognized agricultural university located outside of his/her state of domicile.

fields.schemeName: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for regular, full-time ST students to obtain higher education (post-graduate courses viz. Masters, Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Research) from foreign institutes/universities. The Scheme is implemented through the Indian Embassies.

fields.schemeName: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) Scheme for Scheduled Caste is formulated and funded by the Ministry of Social Justice &Empowerment. The scheme is open to candidates who belong to Scheduled Caste and are pursuing higher studies such as regular and full-time M.Phil.and Ph.D.degrees.

fields.schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) And Research Associateship (RA) For Foreign Nationals
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was initiated keeping in view the political and cultural bilateral relations of India with other developing countries: Asia, Africa, Latin America. The scheme has opened new vistas for foreign students and teachers, enable them to come to India and undertake advanced studies and research.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Students Ready
fields.briefDescription: The Student Rural Entrepreneurship Awareness Development Yojana (READY)  was launched by Hon'ble Prime Minister on 25 July 2015.

fields.schemeName: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students
fields.briefDescription: Maulana Azad National Fellowship For Minority Students was launched in 2009 by the Ministry of Minority Affairs for providing financial aid to students for their higher studies.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: CIFE - Institutional Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: From the year 2010 onwards, the division is offering Masters and PhD in two disciplines namely Fish Nutrition and Feed Technology and Fish physiology and Biochemistry with an objective of moulding professionals with fundamental and advanced knowledge and expertise.

fields.schemeName: State Pre-metric Scholarship For Disabled
fields.briefDescription: The "State Pre-metric Scholarship for Disabled" is a scheme by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Govt. of Maharashtra. The objective of this scheme is to encourage students with disability (SwDs) to pursue education. This scheme is 100% funded by the Govt. of Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Border Areas Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide annual scholarships to economically weaker students from border areas, supporting them in pursuing education up to the degree level.

fields.schemeName: Training Of Motor Driving To VJNT, SBS & OBC
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme that provides light and heavy motor driving, and conductor training to the needy Vimukta Jati, Nomadic Tribes, and Other Backward Class (VJNT, OBC & SBC) candidates.

fields.schemeName: Land Ports Authority Of India (LPAI) Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI) is pleased to announce its annual internship program for the academic year 2025-26. This program provides a unique opportunity for students and research scholars from BBIN countries (Bhutan, India, Nepal, and Bangladesh) to gain practical experience in LPAI

fields.schemeName: Coaching Assistance Scheme For Scheduled Caste Students For Pre-Exam Preparation Like NEET, JEE, GUJCET
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Coaching Assistance Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students for Pre-Exam Preparation like NEET, JEE, GUJCET” was launched by the Govt. of Gujarat during the year 2014-15 to provide coaching assistance to students of Scheduled Caste category who are preparing for exams like NEET, JEE, GUJCET.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Scooty Distribution And Incentive Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Rajasthan has launched the Devnarayan Chatra Scooty Yojana Scheme for the year 2023 in order to encourage female students in the state to study and to address the state’s low female literacy rate.

fields.schemeName: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
fields.briefDescription: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (College Level) In the year 1994-95.

fields.schemeName: Post-matric Scholarship Scheme- Uttar Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The UP scholarship program was started by the state of Uttar Pradesh to increase literacy rates and generate a skilled youth force to boost social and economic growth.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantree Baal Aasheervaad Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Madhya Pradesh State government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Baal Aashirwad Yojana" for orphan youngsters.

fields.schemeName: Vasantrao Naik Merit Awards To The Vjnt Students Who Came First In State Or First In Board Of 10th And 12th Standard Examination
fields.briefDescription: Vasantrao Naik Merit Awards to the VJNT students who came First in State or First in Board of 10th and 12th Standard Examination Scheme Announced by Government Of Maharashtra to Scheme to motivate VJNT students for Higher Education.

fields.schemeName: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt Students
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Maharashtra launched a scheme namely "Tuition fees and examination fees to Vimukta Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT) students.

fields.schemeName: Saphalam Scheme For Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Saphalam Scheme for Transgender Students Pursuing Professional Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Shram Kalyan Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Madhya Pradesh State Government started a scheme for the education of working labourers.

fields.schemeName: Sudama Shishyavritti Scheme (Class 11th and 12th)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools who reside in a hostel, have an annual family income of less than ₹1,00,000/-, and belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

fields.schemeName: Biotechnology Post-Doctoral Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: Young researchers with Ph.D. in relevant areas of Biotechnology are promoted for independent research mentored by eminent scientists/faculty in reputed institutions by providing fellowship.

fields.schemeName: Naunihal Scholarship Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh Naunihal Scholarship Scheme has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh in 2017.

fields.schemeName: KSCSTE Research Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “KSCSTE Research Fellowship” is for encouraging enthusiastic and passionate post-graduate science/ engineering students by supporting them financially in their Ph.D. studies.

fields.schemeName: Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: To facilitate the re-entry of women having a career break to Science research, the Kerala State Council of Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE) launched the “Back-to-Lab Research Fellowship Programme” in 2010.

fields.schemeName: Welfare Measures for Children of Labourers
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide welfare measures in the form of educational stipends, incentives for academic excellence, and financial support for higher education to the children of SC/ST labourers who demonstrate exceptional academic performance and pursue higher education after 10th grade.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramik Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Nirman Shramik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Labour and Employee's State Insurance Department, Government of Odisha. The objective of the scheme is to extend financial assistance to eligible building and other construction workers for continuing education of their wards/children.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Noni Babu Medhavi Shiksha Sahayata Yojana" for Building and other construction worker on 06 January 2012.

fields.schemeName: Award of Pre-matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students Studying from VI to X Standard in Government Schools and Government recognised Private Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students to complete their education up to the secondary level and to avoid dropping out of the Scheduled Caste students from their education.

fields.schemeName: BPL Scholarship for College Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “BPL Scholarship For College Students” was implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Chhattisgarh since 2005 to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from BPL category families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.

fields.schemeName: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Fellowship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Tamil Nadu has introduced the two-year “Tamil Nadu Chief Minister’s Fellowship Programme (TNCMFP)” to harness the energy and talent of young professionals to optimize the governance processes and enhance the service delivery of various programme and policies in Tamil Nadu.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-INAE Distinguished Visiting Professorship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) distinguished visiting Professor scheme envisages promotion of industry-institute interaction.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-National Initiative for Training of Technical Teachers (for Inductee Teachers) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD) and All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) jointly proposed an initiative called “National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT)” to address the technical teachers of the country who plays an active role in the technical education

fields.schemeName: Sant Ravidaas Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Sant Ravidas Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" is a scholarship program launched by the Uttar Pradesh government. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the children of construction workers for their education.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Reimbursement of Educational Expenses to Hearing Impaired Students Pursuing Special Higher Education Courses Inside or Outside the Union Territory of Puducherry
fields.briefDescription: This scheme was introduced by the  Dept of Social Welfare, Govt of Puducherry to provide financial assistance to Hearing Impaired and Visually Impaired students for pursuing their special higher studies. Through this scheme, the reimbursement of the entire fee is granted from the first year onwards.

fields.schemeName: State Agriculture Thesis Grant for M.Sc. Agriculture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “State Agriculture Thesis Grant for M.Sc. Agriculture” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Nagaland to provide a Thesis Grant to all the inhabitants of Nagaland who passed the M.Sc. Agriculture programme.

fields.schemeName: Award of Scholarships to Outstanding NCC Cadets of the UT of Puducherry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and support outstanding NCC cadets. The scheme offers scholarships to eligible candidates in various divisions: Senior Division Boys (Up to graduation), Senior Wing Girls, Junior Division Boys (Up to 12th Standard), and Junior Wing Girls.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Konya Atmonirbhor Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a free Scooty to the meritorious girl students, which will be useful for them to travel to their College.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance (Scheme for the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship to Children of Construction Workers Registered with the MBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides scholarships in the form of financial assistance to children of construction workers registered under the Board. These scholarships will be applicable for courses of study specified by the Board from time to time.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Free Supply of Textbooks, Stationery, Uniforms and Footwears to Poor Children
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, textbooks, notebooks, Uniforms, dictionaries, stationery, etc. are provided free of cost to all students studying in LKG to 12th Standard of all Government and Government-aided Private Schools. The objective of this scheme is to achieve 100% student enrolment.

fields.schemeName: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: The scheme has been implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board to encourage the children (students) of the Labours to increase their enthusiasm and to get higher education through it.

fields.schemeName: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (Science Stream)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to Scheduled Caste (SC) students who are studying in Standard 11th and 12th (Science Stream) and have obtained 70% or more marks in the 10th Standard for private coaching.

fields.schemeName: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
fields.briefDescription: The food bill assistance at the rate of ₹1,500/- per month (Up to 10 Months) will be granted to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students admitted in college-affiliated hostels.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Loan for Higher Study in Foreign Countries
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a loan of ₹15 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4% to offer financial assistance to bright career students of the Scheduled Castes who cannot go abroad for higher studies due to the their poor economic condition.

fields.schemeName: Special Scholarship to Students Belonging to the Most Backward Castes among Scheduled Castes (Vandaniya Sant Shri Vasiyadada Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers special scholarships to students from the Most Backward Castes among the Scheduled Castes category who are enrolled in Standards I to X.

fields.schemeName: One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training (Sainik Welfare)
fields.briefDescription: "One Time Cash Incentive towards Completing ITI, Typewriting, Accountancy, Bookkeeping, Tailoring, Computer Training" by the Dept of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry, provides upto ₹10,000/- to the unemployed Ex-servicemen / Widow/Dependent of the ESM to pursue the mentioned programs/courses.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to SC Students Studying in Medical, Engineering and Diploma Course for Purchasing Educational Instrument
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme ₹10,000/- for Medical students, ₹8,000/- for Engineering students and ₹3,000/- Diploma students granted for purchase of study instrument to the Scheduled Caste students studying in Medical, Engineering, Diploma courses.

fields.schemeName: Aaws Bhatta Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Aaws Bhatta Sahaayata Yojana Government of Madhya Pradesh runs this scheme for those poor students belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe of its state whose college is very far from their house and they have to rent accommodation near the college to study.

fields.schemeName: Post Metric Scholarship - Madhya Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: Under the Post-Matric Scholarship is a Madhya Pradesh Government initiative to provide financial assistance to economically weaker social class students to pursue higher education after matriculation.

fields.schemeName: Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged
fields.briefDescription: The "Sanctioning of Daisy Players to Visually Challenged" scheme aims to distribute daisy players to visually challenged students pursuing 9th Class to Degree as per the Action Plan 2017-18.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
fields.briefDescription: The scheme, implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, provides education loans for pursuing general, professional, and technical courses or training at the graduate and higher levels to minority communities as notified by the Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Intermediate or Equivalent
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible poor Brahmin students.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Professional Education Course" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Education - Post-Graduation (Any course of 2 Years or more duration, after Graduation (10+2+3) will be considered under this category, i.e., M.Sc, M.Com, M.A., M.Tech, M.D., M.Pharm, MBA, etc.)" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas
fields.briefDescription: The "Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas" aims to provide financial assistance to Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh, who secured admission for any master's degree course overseas in reputed institutions for the year or students pursuing part of their course abroad.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools, whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

fields.schemeName: Sudama Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 9th to 10th)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 9 and Class 10 in government schools, whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

fields.schemeName: Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed Class 10 and enrolled in Class 11 Science stream, and to those who have passed Class 12 and enrolled in a B.Sc. course in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology.

fields.schemeName: Videsh Siksha Yojana (MPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme, implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, provides assistance for studying abroad to the children of registered construction workers.Since 2019, this scheme has provided assistance upto 50 students annually in pursuing higher education abroad.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers scholarships for PhD, M.Phil., Postgraduate (qualification-based and qualification cum instrument-based), and sports, as well as merit-based scholarships for graduates, ranging from ₹300/- to ₹600/- per month.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Construction Worker" scheme for education benefit is to give financial assistance for the education of children of registered construction workers having continuous registration for a period of six months under TBOCWWB.

fields.schemeName: Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The "Rajarshri Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship" is an initiative by the Maharashtra Government, specifically designed to encourage scheduled caste students to pursue higher secondary education.  The scholarship aims to enhance the educational standards & competitiveness of students.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Lawyers for Starting their Practice
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to unemployed Adi Dravidar and Tribal lawyers to help them start their legal practice, provided they have registered within the last five years and meet specific income criteria.

fields.schemeName: Book Bank Scheme: I
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides free textbooks to Adi Dravidar/Tribal students pursuing professional courses like Medical, Engineering, Law, MBA, and others, which must be returned to the library after course completion.

fields.schemeName: Award of ₹20,000/- to Best Writers
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides a cash award of ₹20,000/- to the top 10 writers from Adi Dravidar, Tribal, or Adi Dravidar communities converted to Christianity, with one additional spot for a writer from other communities.

fields.schemeName: Professional Education (PEJKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The "Professional Education" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to regular students pursuing Para Medical, ITI, Engineering, and other recognized diploma or professional/technical degree courses.

fields.schemeName: Academic Education (JKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The "Academic Education" scheme by the JKBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Jammu & Kashmir, provides financial assistance to regular students from Class 9th to Post-Graduation.

fields.schemeName: Perarignar Anna Memorial Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aimed at supporting students from the Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC), and Denotified Communities (DNC) in Tamil Through financial assistance to students securing the top two ranks in the 12th Public examination in each district.

fields.schemeName: Postmatric Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial assistance to Backward Classes (BC), Most Backward Classes (MBC) students studying in 11th and 12th standard in English Medium schools. It covers tuition fees and examination fees to promote education among students from economically weaker backgrounds.

fields.schemeName: Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Gagan Bharari Shiksha Yojana for OBC (Dhangar) Students" by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa aims to provide additional financial assistance to OBC (Dhangar) students to supplement their Post Matric Scholarship maintenance allowance.

fields.schemeName: Chhatrawas (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1966-67, the scheme "Chhatrawas" is a welfare scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. The scheme provides free residential facilities in Scheduled Caste hostels for boys and girls studying in educational institutions.

fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students-Bihar
fields.briefDescription: The “Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students-Bihar” aims to provide financial assistance to eligible students from Schedule Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST) for their post-secondary education.

fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme-Bihar
fields.briefDescription: The “Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme-Bihar” aims to provide financial assistance to eligible students from Extremely Backward Classes (EBC) and Other Backward Classes (OBC) for their post-secondary education.

fields.schemeName: Ashram Schools (Scheduled Tribes)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Ashram Schools" was launched on 1st January 1966 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides free accommodation, mess, and education facilities to Scheduled Tribe students.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Apprenticeship Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance the employability of Gujarat's youth through apprenticeship training, offering financial incentives to employers, and promoting skill development across various industries.

fields.schemeName: Civil Service Incentive (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic communities )
fields.briefDescription: The "Civil Service Incentive" by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, offers an incentive of ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 for successful candidates from these communities in MPPSC and UPSC civil service exams.

fields.schemeName: Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Eklavya Prashikshan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide free coaching and financial aid for competitive exam preparation. Eligible students receive free coaching and ₹2,500/- monthly assistance during the coaching period.

fields.schemeName: Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students
fields.briefDescription: The "Maanki Munda Scholarship for Female Students" scheme was launched by the Department of Higher & Technical Education, Govt. of Jharkhand. This scholarship program aims to make the girl students aware of enrollment in technical education, making them self-reliant & providing financial assistance.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" by the Directorate of Higher Education, Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide free coaching and financial assistance to students prepare for national level competitive examinations like JEE, NEET, CLAT, NHMC

fields.schemeName: Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST" by the Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Government of Goa aims to provide laptops to the meritorious students who were born in Goa.

fields.schemeName: Refund of Fees
fields.briefDescription: Under the "Refund of Fees" Scheme, Higher Education Department, Madhya Pradesh, students can get a refund of the remaining fee (including caution money) after deducting ₹100 if they leave college, fail after provisional admission, or have their admission cancelled.

fields.schemeName: State Merit Scholarship to Under Graduate Girls Students
fields.briefDescription: "Merit Scholarship to Undergraduate Girl Students"  aims to promote higher education among meritorious girl students by providing a scholarship amount of ₹3,000 per annum to 10 eligible girl students per government college who have excelled in their 10+2 examination.

fields.schemeName: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support transgender students by providing scholarships to encourage their education and social upliftment. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹225/- per month to cover educational expenses from primary to pre-matric levels.

fields.schemeName: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Post Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support transgender students pursuing post-matric education. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to cover educational expenses for their post-matric studies.

fields.schemeName: Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and EWS categories by providing financial aid for accommodation. The students receive ₹2,000/- per month for up to 10 months per academic year.

fields.schemeName: Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Bunkar Parivar Ke Pratibhavan Chatra-Chatraon Ko Protsahan Puraskar Yojana" aims to motivate and encourage children of weaver families for higher education. Monetary rewards are given to talented students who score well in 10th/12th board exams.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Help Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Coaching Help Scheme" provides financial support to non-reserved category students pursuing science in Standard-11 and Standard-12 by covering additional tuition costs.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Science Education (POSE) Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage meritorious students to pursue higher studies in Basic and Natural Science subjects, such as B.Sc., B.S., B.Stat., B.Math., Integrated M.Sc., or M.S., in India. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana State Council for Science, Innovation & Technology.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (PM-Vidyalaxmi) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Pradhan Mantri Vidyalaxmi (Pm-vidyalaxmi) Scheme" aims to provide financial support for higher education through education loans. Under this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- is provided to meritorious students seeking admission to domestic institutions.

fields.schemeName: Subsidy for School Uniforms to the Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide cash subsidies for school uniforms to students from Nursery to Class XII in government and aided schools. Benefits include annual payments ranging from ₹1,100/- to ₹1,500/-, ensuring financial support for all eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.00 lakh, who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.

fields.schemeName: Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jan-Nayak Karpoori Thakur Kalyan Hostel Scheme" by the BC & EBC Welfare Department, Bihar provides hostel facilities for students near Saharsa District with food grains (9 kg rice, 6 kg wheat) and ₹1000/- per month as a grant.

fields.schemeName: Urdu Scholarship- Rajasthan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote the Urdu language among female students at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Under this scheme, a monthly scholarship is provided to undergraduate and postgraduate students who are studying Urdu as an optional subject.

fields.schemeName: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University
fields.briefDescription: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Engineering University" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹1,000/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized engineering universities in Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Distance Education Scheme for Girls
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support girls' higher education through distance learning by reimbursing their course fees for UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate, and PG Diploma undertaken by girls through distance education in Rajasthan.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Chhattisgarh Students Studying Outside the State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support native Chhattisgarh students pursuing engineering degrees outside the state by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹2,000/-. This initiative benefits meritorious students enrolled in recognised engineering colleges outside Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Free Computer Training
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.

fields.schemeName: State Art Exhibition (Student Category)
fields.briefDescription: The "State Art Exhibition (Student Category)" is an annual event organized by the Art, Culture and Museums Department, Government of Goa, to promote and encourage creativity in the visual arts field among local students.

fields.schemeName: Free Scooty Distribution for Girls (GEN-CATEGAORY-EWS)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, meritorious girl students from government and private schools who have scored 85% or above in the Class 10th and 12th (Arts, Commerce, Science streams) examinations are provided with a free scooty, along with a helmet and petrol.

fields.schemeName: Operation of Ashram Hostels
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free accommodation, nutritious meals, educational materials, uniforms, personal hygiene items, and other facilities are provided to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students residing in ashram hostels operated by the Tribal Area Development Department.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to SC Students Appearing in the Mains Examination of UPSC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial grants to the SC students for appearing in the UPSC Mains Exam. An amount upto ₹50,000/- is provided to each beneficiary, subject to budget provision. The assistance is extended depending on the applicant satisfying the eligibility criteria and the documents submitted.

fields.schemeName: Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Uniform Assistance for Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes students Studying in Class 1st to 8th" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides ₹900/- for three pairs of uniforms to students from NT/DNT Castes in government and aided primary schools.

fields.schemeName: Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Socially and Educationally Backward Classes for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Dept., Gujarat, supports education for Socially and Educationally Backward Classes students by providing a monthly stipend of ₹400/-.

fields.schemeName: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: APJ Abdul Kalam Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to minority students pursuing Polytechnic Diploma courses. Through this scheme, scholarships are provided to eligible minority students. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Minority Welfare.

fields.schemeName: New Akanksha Scheme (Educational Loan) (GNDTDC)
fields.briefDescription: Under the scheme, educational loans of up to ₹10 lakh are provided to students belonging to Nomadic and Denotified Tribes communities for pursuing higher professional and technical education at the graduate and postgraduate levels.

fields.schemeName: Prof. Joseph Mundassery Scholarship Award
fields.briefDescription: The aim is to provide financial assistance to financially backwards students from minority communities. Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible students from Christian, Buddhist, Jain, Sikh, Muslim, and Parsi communities.

fields.schemeName: Food Bill Assistant for Medical & Engineering Students of SEBC
fields.briefDescription: The Government of Gujarat provides financial assistance to students belonging to Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) who are studying in self-financed medical and engineering colleges/universities.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Chhatra Protsahan Scholarship Scheme (Secondary Level)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among students entering Classes 9 and 10 by providing financial assistance to meritorious students, based on their performance in a competitive examination conducted by the SCERT, Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Tiatr Research Scholarship Program
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage college and university students to undertake research in Tiatr, its song, and music. It provides scholarships and publication opportunities for research work, targeting students pursuing Graduation, Post-Graduation, and PhD studies.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 1 - SHRESHTA Schools (Best CBSE Private Residential Schools)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide access to high quality education to students from Scheduled Caste communities in best private residential schools. It provides scholarships and bridge courses to meritorious Scheduled Caste students selected through national entrance test.

fields.schemeName: Fellowship Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Fellowship Scholarship Scheme" by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide financial help to students by granting an annual monetary award to those who secure 70% or more marks in Class 10th and pursue higher education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Scheme For Residential Education For Students in High Schools in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA): Mode 2 - NGO Operated Schools
fields.briefDescription: The sub-scheme aims to provide quality education and opportunities to students from SC communities through grant-in-aid institutions run by Non-Governmental Organizations and residential high schools, addressing the gap in service deficient Scheduled Caste dominant areas in the education sector.

fields.schemeName: Sports Scholarship (UG) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹800/- in the form of scholarships to undergraduate students who excel in sports.

fields.schemeName: Monsanto Scholarship (M.Sc. Agriculture Science and Agriculture Biotechnology)
fields.briefDescription: he scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Agricultural Science & Agricultural Biotechnology by awarding them scholarships for three semesters.

fields.schemeName: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the wards of recognized Goan artists who are pursuing higher education, thereby addressing the economic challenges faced by artist families in supporting their children's educational aspirations and ensuring continuity of educational opportunities.

fields.schemeName: Dr. S.K. Sharma (Ph.D. Mathematics)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per year to deserving scholars pursuing a Ph.D. in Mathematics, supporting advanced research and reducing their financial burden.

fields.schemeName: Laptop-e Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to equip Class XI students with individual portable computer systems to enhance digital learning, knowledge acquisition, and skill attainment for employment or self-employment. Students receive one entry-level Laptop or Notebook equipped with specific technical requirements.

fields.schemeName: Computer Training Scheme for Visually Impaired Persons
fields.briefDescription: The scheme helps visually impaired individuals by giving them computer and screen-reading training and providing a laptop to the beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to Divyang Students (Class 1 to 8)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹600/- for students in Class 1 to 5 and ₹960/- for students in Class 6 to 8, to regularly enrolled disable students.

fields.schemeName: Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time award of ₹50,000/- is given to each candidate from Uttarakhand who has been selected for service at premier defence academies such as the NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, and IAF.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship to Poor Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Dhyanpal Singh Memorial Award (for Final-Year Undergraduate Students of All Colleges)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support and encourage meritorious students by providing them with monetary assistance of ₹30,000/- in their final year of undergraduate studies, thereby reducing financial burdens.

fields.schemeName: Shri Varun Panwar Memorial Award for B.Sc. Agriculture (2nd Year, 3rd Year, and 4th Year) Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize and encourage B.Sc. Agriculture students in their 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year of study by awarding them a cash prize of ₹10,000/- for their academic excellence.

fields.schemeName: Dr. S.K. Mukherjee Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture Students (2nd & 3rd Year)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to meritorious students pursuing a B.Sc. Agriculture course in their 2nd and 3rd years of study by awarding a one-year scholarship of ₹1,100 per month.

fields.schemeName: Supply Free Laptops to Visually Impaired Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free laptops to visually impaired students pursuing courses. The scheme is provisioned for providing laptops to the visually impaired students to pursue professional courses after XII, under-graduate and post-graduate courses.

fields.schemeName: Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: "Vyasakabi Fakir Mohan Bhasabruti Scholarship" is a Scholarship by the Higher Education Department, Govt. of Odisha. The objective of the scheme is the promotion of the Odia Language by way of encouraging meritorious students to take up higher studies in Odia Language at the U.G. and P.G. levels.

fields.schemeName: State Horticulture Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The “State Horticulture Scholarship” is a scholarship scheme, launched by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Nagaland to provide scholarship/stipend to students who are pursuing B.Sc. (Horticulture) M.Sc. (Horticulture) Ph.D. (Horticulture) courses.

fields.schemeName: Sudakshya For Girls Child Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: This scholarship provides financial assistance to all deserving students who want to pursue higher studies.  Under this scholarship scheme, the students fulfilling the eligibility criteria will receive a maintenance allowance and other benefits.

fields.schemeName: Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award For Meritorious Children With Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award for Meritorious Children with Disabilities” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Scholarship for Sainik Schools
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme Of Scholarship For Sainik Schools" was launched by the Directorate Of Higher and Technical Education, Meghalaya, to prepare young boys for a career in the Cadre of the Armed Forces. The scholarships are awarded to students whose family income is less than ₹8,000/- per month.

fields.schemeName: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti
