fields.briefDescription: Under Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti Madhya Pradesh Government aimed at providing financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to these marginalized communities.

fields.schemeName: Research (PhD) Scholarship for SC/ST Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, offers financial support for PhD research work to SC/ST students. Eligible students receive ₹16,000/- per month, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year, which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.

fields.schemeName: Prathibha Scholarship Programme
fields.briefDescription: Prathibha Scholarship Programme is aimed at motivating bright Students to higher studies in Science by awarding Scholarships. Prathibha Scholars are also provided opportunities to attend Science Orientation Programmes and interact with pioneers in Science through the SPEED Scheme.

fields.schemeName: Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Chief Minister Sarbananda Sonowal launched the Assam Abhinandan Education Loan Subsidy Scheme at the Srimanta Sankardev International Auditorium on 26 December 2019 in the presence of Finance Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, , several senior officials of the State Finance Department, and bank officials

fields.schemeName: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
fields.briefDescription: A Travel Grant Scheme by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and by the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE), for the students from AICTE approved Engineering College/institutions. The scheme aims at enhancing the quality of engineering education in the country.

fields.schemeName: Exposure Visits To The Assam Legislative Assembly
fields.briefDescription: The Exposure Visits to the Assam Legislative Assembly scheme was introduced in the budget speech during the first Budget Session in July 2016. It aims to provide an opportunity for Political Science students in Assam to visit and observe the functioning of the Assam Legislative Assembly.

fields.schemeName: Haryana Merit Cum Means Scheme For Minority
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from minority communities in Haryana for pursuing professional and technical courses.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students (Delhi)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students" aims to support SC students financially for post-matriculation studies. Benefits include fee reimbursement and monthly allowances. Intended beneficiaries are SC students with a family income below ₹2,50,000/- annually.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister Research Chair (PMRC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to attract top Indian-origin researchers and scientists back to India to strengthen the higher education and research ecosystem. The scheme provides 120 research positions across three categories: Young Research Fellows, Senior Research Fellows, and Research Chairs.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides comprehensive support through six key components, including integrated village development under Pradhan Mantri Adi Adarsh Gram Yojana, development of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups, support to Tribal Research Institutes, and Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarships.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Higher Education for Young Achievers Scheme (SHREYAS)  (OBC & Others)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure the educational empowerment of OBC and EBC students. Through this scheme, fellowships and interest subsidies on overseas education loans are provided to eligible beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: BSR Fellowship Scheme for Science Students - UGC
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide opportunities to meritorious candidates to undertake advanced studies and research leading to Ph.D. degrees in sciences.

fields.schemeName: The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University
fields.briefDescription: "The Scheme for Fellowship to Under Graduate Students for Various Faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University" provides monthly fellowship to meritorious undergraduate students across various faculties of Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers educational loans of up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹20 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad.

fields.schemeName: New Akanksha Scheme (Higher Education Loan) (GGDC)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides educational loans of up to ₹15.00 lakh to students belonging to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from socially and educationally backward classes for pursuing higher professional courses such as medical, dental, engineering, pharmacy, etc.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Sahay for the Preparation of NEET, JEE, GUJCET Examination to both Socially and Educationally Backward Class Trainees/Students and Female Students and Economically Backward Class Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) and Economically Backward Class (EBC) students with coaching fee assistance. Up to ₹20,000 or actual fee is provided for one exam preparation.

fields.schemeName: Special Incentive Assistance to Socially and Educationally Backward Class Trainees for Pre-preparation of Competitive Examination
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, to provide financial assistance of up to ₹20,000/- to socially and educationally backward class students preparing for state and central government job exams.

fields.schemeName: Maintenance of Govt Boys and Girls Hostels (SC)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, it provides free hostel, food, and academic facilities to scheduled caste students pursuing post-SSC education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre- Matric Scholarships Scheme for Scheduled Castes & Others
fields.briefDescription: The Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Castes & others is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme
fields.briefDescription: VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.

fields.schemeName: SERB International Research Experience
fields.briefDescription: The Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), a statutory body under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India has launched "SERB International Research Experience (SIRE)".

fields.schemeName: J.C. Bose Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Netaji Subhas - ICAR International Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: Introduced in 2009-10, the “Netaji Subhas - ICAR International Fellowship” is a scheme by to develop competent human resource that are trained in the identified best laboratories in the world (for Indian candidates) and similarly expose overseas candidates to the best Agriculture Universities.

fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana (Scholarship For Promotion Of Aptitude & Research In Stamps As A Hobby)
fields.briefDescription: "Deen Dayal SPARSH Yojana" awards annual scholarships to students who have good academic records and are also pursuing 'Philately' as a hobby. The objective is to “Promote Philately among children at a young age in a sustainable manner that can reinforce and supplement the academic curriculum.

fields.schemeName: LLB Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: Department of Justice introduced an Internship Programme for young law students. The purpose is to well acquaint law students in the field of research & referencing work, in various specialized areas of justice delivery, such as Tele-Law, Nyaya Bandhu etc.

fields.schemeName: National Scheme Of Incentive To Girls For Secondary Education
fields.briefDescription: The National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education promotes the girl child's enrolment of 14-18 years age group at secondary stage, who passes class 8th and subsequently drops out for various socio-economic reasons.

fields.schemeName: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship For Single Girl Child
fields.briefDescription: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a Fellowship Scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education, for pursuing research work leading to the award of a Ph.D. degree. The target group of this scheme is the ‘single girl child'.

fields.schemeName: State Research Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: This scholarship is specially designed for students who are pursuing research work. Under the scheme, beneficiaries will get cash awards to conduct their research work.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
fields.briefDescription: Financial assistance scheme providing up to ₹36,000 annually to visually challenged permanent college teachers for reader assistance, Braille books, and learning aids. Implemented by University Grants Commission to support teaching, research, and academic independence.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "National Renewable Energy Internship Scheme" by MNRE provides internship opportunities to facilitate students pursuing undergraduate/graduate/post-graduate degrees (Engineering, Science, Management, Law, etc) or research scholars enrolled in recognized institutes/universities.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarships to the Children of Those Engaged in Occupations Involving Cleaning and Prone to Health Hazards
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to children whose parents/guardians belong to one of the following categories, to pursue Pre-Matric education: Tanners, Flayers, Waste Pickers and Persons who are either presently engaged in Manual Scavenging.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Statistics and Programme Implementation
fields.schemeName: Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students
fields.briefDescription: MoSPI is implementing the scheme of Internship for Post-graduate/Research Students of Statistics/ Mathematical Statistics/ Operations Research/ Economics/ Demography or any of the applied field of Statistics of recognized Universities//Institutions.

fields.schemeName: Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The Department of Biotechnology has instituted a scheme known as the “Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship”. The scheme is aimed at Indian Nationals who are working overseas in various fields of biotechnology and life sciences and are interested in taking up scientific research positions in India.

fields.schemeName: Research Associates (RA)
fields.briefDescription: The Research Associates (RAs) of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT) in India are individuals who engage in research work under the DBT-Research Associateship Program in Biotechnology and its was started in 1999.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Development Of North Eastern Region
fields.schemeName: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: The scholarship scheme aims to support students of the North Eastern States undergoing studies in different disciplines at different levels in Institutions inside as well as outside the North-East but within the country.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Railway Protection Force
fields.briefDescription: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for RPF was announced by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India in his address to the nation from the historical Red Ford on 15th August 2005 to encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of Ex/Serving RPF/RPSF personnel& widows.

fields.schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: The "Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme" was launched by Secretary, Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India on the occasion of IGSTC’s 11th Foundation Day on 14th June 2021 to support young Indian researchers for industrial exposure in German

fields.schemeName: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: This programme is aimed at encouraging Postdoctoral researchers/fresh PhDs in S&T with appreciable track record and having aptitude for applied research and technology development.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
fields.briefDescription: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research scheme is a prestigious initiative of Science and Engineering Research Board (SERB), Department of Science & Technology, Government of India towards the advancement of university research engagements in line with industry requirement.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Fellowship for Students with Disabilities
fields.briefDescription: A Scheme "National Fellowship For Students With Disabilities" was initiated by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities under the "Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment".

fields.schemeName: Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree)
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by MoE for Girl Students admitted in 1st or 2nd Year of the technical degree course in an AICTE approved institution. The benefits are provided for max. 4 years for first-year admitted students and max. 3 years for second-year admitted students through lateral entry.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme Of The Ministry Of Labour & Employment
fields.briefDescription: Through the Internship Scheme, the Ministry of Labour & Employment engage eligible students as “Interns" to work for mutual benefit. The “Interns” shall have an opportunity to know about the Government functioning and Department Policy issues in the Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Quality Improvement Programme (QIP)
fields.briefDescription: The primary objective of this scheme is to enhance the expertise and capabilities of faculty members in degree and diploma-level institutions across the country. The aim is to enable teachers to acquire Master's and Doctoral degrees and instil in them a culture of research.

fields.schemeName: Post Doctoral Fellowship to Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Candidates
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been initiated keeping in view social background of candidates from the deprived section of society and to provide them an opportunity to undertake advanced studies and research in Science, Engineering & Technology, Humanities and Social Sciences in Indian Universities/Institutions.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Upgradation of Merit of Scheduled Caste Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to upgrade the merit of Scheduled Caste students by providing them with facilities for all round development through education in residential or non-residential schools, addressing their educational deficiencies that prevent them from taking advantage of reservation quotas.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeShortTitle: SUPPLY OF SCHOOL UNIFORM AND TIE BELT
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Uniform and Tie belt to other than SC/ST Boys Students of Std I to VIII studying in Govt Schools

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Stationery to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students (who are not covered under SC, ST, or OBC) is welfare and motivation to the children of these categories by providing financial assistance at pre-matriculation or secondary stage.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students - DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide educational empowerment and financial assistance to OBC, EBC, and DNT students. Through this scheme, ₹4,000/- per annum is provided to eligible students studying in Classes 9 and 10 in Government Schools.

fields.schemeName: Post Doctoral Fellowship (PRL Funded)
fields.briefDescription: The fellowship offers candidates the opportunity to pursue research in PRL’s cutting-edge science & engineering research areas. The tenure of the fellowship is for a maximum of two years, subject to annual progress reviews. The fellowship provides a competitive stipend, research opportunities.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for students with Disabilities - DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarship assistance and educational support to students with benchmark disabilities. Through this scheme, financial assistance, tuition fee support, maintenance allowance, and related benefits are provided to eligible students with disabilities.

fields.schemeName: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Education Of Children & Widows Of Ex-Servicemen
fields.briefDescription: A scheme to provide financial assistance to Ex-Servicemen and their widows for helping them in educating their child (for maximum two children) up to graduation and also for widows to pursue Post Graduation degree.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: SMILE - Comprehensive Rehabilitation For Welfare Of Transgender Persons
fields.briefDescription: A scheme to provide Financial Assistance in the form of scholarships is provided to Transgender students studying in secondary school (IX & X)  & senior secondary school (XI & XII) to reduce the incidence of dropout and support their educational aspirations.

fields.schemeName: Pre Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by Ministry of Tribal Affairs for regular, full time students from Scheduled Tribe studying in Class 9th and 10th, in a Government School or in a School recognized by Govt. or a Central/State Board of Secondary Education.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Digital India Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: An opportunity for a student to secure practical work experience under the guidance of a qualified and experienced Supervisor/Mentor in Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) in the form of Digital India Internship Scheme.

fields.schemeName: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships In Sciences
fields.briefDescription: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences was introduced by the UGC. In addition to the existing RA/PDF positions provided by various funding agencies, a need was felt for a PDF scheme running in a flexible mode, with fast track, online handling, and decision-making.

fields.schemeName: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences
fields.briefDescription: The scheme of Junior Research Fellowship in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Science by UGC, Dept. of Education, is open to candidates who qualify for the National Eligibility Test-Junior Research Fellowship(NET-JRF) of the UGC and the UGC-Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (UGC-CSIR).

fields.schemeName: AICTE - Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship
fields.briefDescription: A Fellowship Scheme by AICTE, MoE. The Distinguished Chair Professor Fellowship intends to utilize the expertise of highly qualified and experienced superannuated professionals who have made an unparalleled, exceptional professional contribution to society in their respective fields/disciplines.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Hostel Maintenance Allowance
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is for the Students whose parent's annual Income is below 800000 and Students whose parents are Marginal Land Holder and registered laborers.

fields.schemeName: Akanksha Scheme
fields.briefDescription: According to the plan of the Government of Madhya Pradesh, Tribal Affairs Department, the target is to provide coaching to the scheduled tribe students of the state for the preparation of national entrance examination (JEE, NEET / AIIMS, CLET) from reputed coaching institutes in division headquarter

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Mukhya Mantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) scholarship is a scholarship program offered by the government of Gujarat, India for students pursuing higher education.

fields.schemeName: LIDCOM Education Loan Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Education Loan Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, finance of upto ₹ 20,00,000 is provided for post graduate students in the 18-50 years age group from Charmakar Community for studies in India and in abroad.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship To 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers Undergoing D.El.Ed Programme At DIETs And CTTC Sohra
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Scholarship to 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers undergoing D.El.Ed Programme at DIETs and CTTC Sohra” was launched by the Dept. of Education, Govt. of Meghalaya in 2012. The scheme offers a scholarship of ₹5000 p.m. for 2 years (10 months per year) to attract the state's best talent.

fields.schemeName: NAMO E-Tablet Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Namo Tablet Yojana in Gujarat is a state-specific version of the central government's PM Tablet Scheme. The scheme was launched in 2017 by the Gujarat government and aims to distribute tablets to around 3.5 lakh students in the state.

fields.schemeName: Stipends To Trainees In Industrial Training Institute
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Trainees in Industrial Training Institute” was launched by the Department of Social Justice and Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra for Scheduled Caste students in Industrial Training Institute.

fields.schemeName: Non-Governmental Aided Organization (Special Schools And Vocational Training Centre) For Disabled
fields.briefDescription: In this scheme, Special Education is provided to children with disability who are below the age of 18 years. The child should be enrolled in a special school run by a Non-Governmental Aided Organization. Vocational Training is given to special children above the age of 18 years.

fields.schemeName: Rehabilitation Treatment For The Disabled
fields.briefDescription: The government of Meghalaya provides rehabilitation treatment for persons with disabilities under the "Disability Rehabilitation Scheme".

fields.schemeName: Vidya Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Vidya scheme under the Education Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh is a scheme where a girl child who is studying in Class VI is provided with an incentive of Rs. 10,000/- as fixed deposit in SBI in the name of individual girl child till she completes Class – XII.

fields.schemeName: Vidyasiri food And Accommodation Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Vidyasiri-Food and Accommodation Scholarship Scheme (VFAS) is a government initiative in Karnataka that provides financial assistance to students belonging to backward classes pursuing post-matric courses in recognized institutions. Scheme offers a monthly stipend of Rs. 1,500 for10 months

fields.schemeName: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T And S.B.C Girls Students Studying In 8th To 10 Std
fields.briefDescription: Savitribai Phule Scholarship is a Scholarship Scheme by the Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Govt. of Maharashtra, to encourage enrollment and to decrease the dropout ratio of Girls in education.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Jankalyan (Shiksha Protsahan Yojna)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through the Mukhyamantri Jankalyan Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, financial assistance will be provided for education to students of Madhya Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Chief Minister’s Paryatan Siksha Yojana” was launched by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh to promote tourism and develop the industry by means of trained individuals.

fields.schemeName: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana” was launched by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi vide Cabinet Decision No.2526 Dated 12-12-2017.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: NIELIT Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Programme by NIELIT is an opportunity for a student to secure first-hand and practical work experience under the guidance of qualified and experienced Supervisors/Mentors. It also aims at active participation in the learning process through experimentation.

fields.schemeName: Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme
fields.briefDescription: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme" for Girls students.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Assistance Scheme for Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination to Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Financial Aid For Providing Hostel Facility To Transgender Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Financial Aid for Providing Hostel Facility to Transgender Students” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme For PG/Research Students In Directorate General Of Trade Remedies (DGTR)
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Scheme by the Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) provides opportunities for young scholars, especially from Law / Economics stream, interested in learning about trade remedial investigations.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme Of Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO)
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Scheme of Employees’ Provident Fund Organization invites applications for Internships from students for engagement as “Interns” with EPFO. The “Interns” shall have an opportunity to know about the EPFO’s functioning and Departmental Policy issues in EPFO and Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
fields.briefDescription: The National Green Tribunal provides opportunities to college students by holding Summer Internship Programs (March, April, May and July ordinarily) and Winter Internship Programs (November, December and January ordinarily) Internship Programs for LL.B./ LL.M./ Env. Studies/ Research Students.

fields.schemeName: Young Investigators Programme in Biotechnology
fields.briefDescription: The programme “Young Investigator’s Programme in Biotechnology (YIPB)” is a research support programme that aims to provide quick research support to young researchers to pursue their ideas in newly emerging and front-line areas of research in Biotechnology.

fields.schemeName: National Scheme of Apprenticeship Training
fields.briefDescription: The primary goal of this scheme is to bridge the gap in practical experience for fresh Graduate Engineers, Diploma holders, and 10+2 Vocational pass-outs in approximately 10,000 industrial establishments. The apprentices undergo a one-year training period, receiving a monthly stipend.

fields.schemeName: Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Mahila Kamgar Kaushal Unnayan Evan Theka Shramik, Hamaal Tatha Ghareloo Mahila Kamgaar Parivar Sashaktikaran Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to financially assist the SC parents for sending school their daughters who otherwise earn livelihood for the family engaging themselves in menial labour.

fields.schemeName: Stipend to Scheduled Caste Trainees in Technical Training Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial support to Scheduled Tribe candidates/trainees who are undergoing training in the Government Technical Training Institutions of the Union Territory of Puducherry.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-QUALITY IMPROVEMENT (FOREIGN UNIVERSITY) PROGRAMME
fields.briefDescription: The All India Council for Technical Education in its 55th Meeting of the Council held on 14th August 2018 approved the Quality Improvement Programme (Foreign University) (QIP-FU). The QIP(FU) is an extension of the QIP program launched by the Government of India in the year 1970.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Technical Book Writing & Translation scheme has been launched by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to promote the use of 'Scheduled Regional Language' in Technical Education for creating knowledge base in local language.

fields.schemeName: Kaushal Vikas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Kaushal Vikas Mission (UPSDM) is a scheme launched by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to equip young people in the state with the necessary skills for employment.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of College Fees for Scheduled Caste Students in Professional Colleges (Top 20)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, reimbursement of tuition fees and examination fees is facilitated for students who have achieved marks above 75% in the Higher Secondary Course Examination and secured a place in the 'Top 20' Rank. The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Cash Award to the Meritorious Visually Impaired Students Obtaining First Three Ranks at the State Level in the SSLC and HSC Examination
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to award cash prizes to meritorious differently-abled persons (visually challenged students) who are studying in government and private schools of Puducherry and secure first, second and third rank concerning total marks in the SSLC and HSC exams.

fields.schemeName: Visitor's Award
fields.briefDescription: The Awards are given to recognize excellence in research and innovation of faculty members/researchers of the Central Universities

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to recognize and promote quality education amongst Students belonging to OBC, EBC and DNT categories by providing full financial support. The Scheme will cover OBC/EBC/DNT students for pursuing studies beyond Class XII.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: PM-YASASVI: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to the OBC, EBC and DNT students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.

fields.schemeName: State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “State Agriculture Scholarship for B.Sc. & M.Sc. Agriculture” was launched by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Nagaland to provide educational assistance to students who are undergoing undergraduate (B.Sc. Agriculture) and post-graduate programme (M.Sc. Agriculture).

fields.schemeName: Vishist Coaching Scheme (GBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The “Vishist Coaching Scheme” is implemented by Gujarat Building & Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board, Labour, Govt. of Gujarat. Under this scheme, both the registration fee & coaching/tuition fees will be reimbursed/paid for the career development of the children of construction workers.

fields.schemeName: Grant to Meritorious Wards of Ex-Servicemen in Academics (Lump Sum Grant)
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the academically meritorious wards of the ESM / Widows of ESM who have secured the top three ranks in academics are provided with lump sum grants of upto ₹18,000. The application should be submitted within three months from the date of publication of the result.

fields.schemeName: Special Scholarship to SC Students in Selected Schools
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to SC students studying in famous private selected schools i.e. Doon School, Dehradun; Sofiya School, Abu; Mayo school, Ajmer; Sainik School, Balachadi; Mahila Sainik School, Kherva; Dist. Mehsana, etc. will be paid actual fees upto limit of ₹50,000/- p.a.

fields.schemeName: Pre-SSC Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Parixitlal Majmudar Scholarship)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Caste students who are studying in Class 1 to 10 in Government/Grant-in-Aid Schools/Private Schools.

fields.schemeName: Post-Matric Scholarships for Scheduled Castes Students- Gujarat
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to appreciably increase the Gross Enrolment Ratio of SC students in higher education with a focus on those from the poorest households, by providing financial assistance at post-matriculation or postsecondary stage to enable them to complete their education.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Award of Scholarships to School or College-Going Children of Employees/Industrial Employees in Various Establishments
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme for Award of Scholarships to School or College-Going Children of Employees/Industrial Employees in Various Establishments" by the Dept of Labour and Employment, Goa provides financial assistance to the children of industry workers to support their educational pursuits.

fields.schemeName: Mahadevi Verma Shramik Pustak Kraya Dhan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Mahadevi Verma Shramik Pustak Kraya Dhan Yojana (MVSPKDPY) is a scheme launched by the Uttar Pradesh government in 2022 to provide financial assistance to the daughters of construction workers for purchasing books.

fields.schemeName: Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under the Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana, the Government of Madhya Pradesh provided financial support to those people who are not able to study due to financial circumstances.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education (GBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Through the "Financial Assistance for Education (GBOCWWB)" scheme, the worker registered with the Board is provided with financial assistance, as determined by the Board, for the education of their children. The applications are accepted offline.

fields.schemeName: Assistance to Law Graduates
fields.briefDescription: The "Assistance to Law Graduates" scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000 will be given to the differently abled Law graduates for enrolment in the Bar Council as lawyer.

fields.schemeName: Special Education - Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The scheme 'Special Education by Welfare of Differently Abled Persons' was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide free special education, & vocational training to the visually impaired, hearing-impaired person.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of New and Renewable Energy
fields.schemeName: Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) Internship
fields.briefDescription: The SECI Internship Policy is designed to provide practical experience to students in the renewable energy sector. The program aims to give interns exposure to SECI's various divisions, helping them understand the renewable energy sector.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The aim of this scheme is to allow short-term exposure to youth about working of the different sections of the Department of Forests and Wildlife, GNCTD as ‘Interns’.

fields.schemeName: Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class
fields.briefDescription: "The Bharati Scheme for Education - 6th Class to 10th Class" encourages Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh to continue their education. Under this scheme, financial assistance for the academic year will be granted to eligible poor Brahmin student applicants.

fields.schemeName: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana (For Scheduled Caste Girls)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste girls who pass the Class 10th and enroll in the Class 11th at a government or recognized institution and study regularly are given an incentive of ₹3,000/- per year.

fields.schemeName: Hostel Scheme for Disabled Students
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide hostel facilities to such disabled students who are taking admission in class 11th and above on a regular basis and in case hostel facilities are not available in the schools/colleges, by renting private buildings.

fields.schemeName: Scholarship for Children of Deceased/Disabled/Retired Government Employees
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to motivate children of government employees who are deceased, retired, or disabled. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹50/- to ₹250/- are provided to children of these government employees who are studying in Class 1 to Class 12 in government schools.

fields.schemeName: State Government SC Scholarship (Class 1 to 10)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to improve educational status of SC students by providing scholarships. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to SC girl students in Classes 1 to 5,and to both boys & girls in SC category in Classes 6 to 10.

fields.schemeName: Student Welfare Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to economically weaker ST students to meet their emergency needs in special circumstances. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to ST students studying in Class 1 to 10 in cases of urgency or emergency.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Free Books and Stationery to SC/ST Students
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free books and stationery are provided to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses at government colleges. Eligible students receive books worth ₹1,500/- and stationery worth ₹500/- per year.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, an incentive amount is provided to minority students who pass the Intermediate/Matriculation/Fauquania/Maulvi examinations with first-class marks from the Bihar School Examination Board/Bihar Madrasa Education Board.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Incentive/Award of Prizes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Incentive/Award of Prizes” offers incentives to One Boy and One Girl each from Adi Dravidar/ Tribal/ Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity who have secured highest mark who have achieved top marks in 10th and 12th standard examinations.

fields.schemeName: Providing Scholarships to Children of BOC Workers
fields.briefDescription: The Andhra Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides scholarships to children of registered workers. The scheme covers up to two children per family. Students of 9th to 12th grade (Intermediate), ITI and Graduation level will receive financial assistance.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Incentive/Award of Prizes-For Each Subjects
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers cash awards to students from the Adi Dravidar, Tribal communities, and Adi Dravidar converts to Christianity for excelling in academic subjects in 10th and Plus 2 examinations.

fields.schemeName: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department: Scholarship-Public Examination Fee for 10th and 12th Std.
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides reimbursement of public examination fees for 10th and 12th standard students from the Adi Dravidar, Tribal, and Adi Dravidar Converted to Christianity communities, with no income limit.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Meritorious Students to Pursue Higher Secondary Education in the Best Schools of Tamil Nadu
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to the top 10 students from each district (based on 10th-grade public exam results) who study in government high schools, enabling them to pursue higher secondary education in select private schools of their choice across Tamil Nadu.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students
fields.briefDescription: "Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students" scheme aims to improve the educational status of handicapped children studying in standards 1st to 10th. Monthly stipends (₹200 to ₹300) are provided to parents who are unable to send their children to school due to economic reasons.

fields.schemeName: Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students
fields.briefDescription: "Merit Based Scholarship Scheme for Dhangar Students" by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa aims to motivate students by providing merit-based awards and financial incentives (ranging from ₹5,000/- to ₹20,000/-) to high-performing students who are economically weak.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course
fields.briefDescription: The Reimbursement of the MS-CIT Course scheme was launched by the Maharashtra Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MBOCWW), Labour Department Maharashtra.

fields.schemeName: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana (Maharashtra)
fields.briefDescription: The "Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana" scheme is implemented by the Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra. This Centrally Sponsored Scheme is aimed at providing insurance and scholarship benefits to landless labourers in rural areas, aged 18 to 59 years.

fields.schemeName: State Scholarship of Class 6th to 10th (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. It provides ₹200 per year for boys and ₹600 per year for girls from Scheduled Caste communities, until 31st October.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Vyavsayik Pathyakram Margdarshan Evam Utpreran Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This initiative offers free coaching to the students belonging to the backward class (BC) and extremely backward class (EBC) of Bihar, helping them prepare for competitive exams like NET, GATE, JRF, Ph.D., and M.Phil.

fields.schemeName: Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class
fields.briefDescription: "Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class" aims to provide quality pre-examination training for various employment-oriented competitive examinations to talented but economically disadvantaged young men and women.

fields.schemeName: Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Jharkhand State Scheduled Tribe Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme" aims to promote education and reduce dropout rates among Scheduled Tribe students. It provides financial assistance to students from Class 1st to 10th who are studying in government schools in Jharkhand.

fields.schemeName: Incentives to Students who Passed the Civil Service Examination
fields.briefDescription: The "Incentives to Students Who Passed the Civil Service Examination" scheme provides incentives to Scheduled Tribe candidates who clear the Civil Services exams (Preliminary, Main, and Interview) conducted by M.P. PSC and UPSC.

fields.schemeName: Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 12th September 2013, the scheme "Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination (Scheduled Tribes)" provides financial assistance, education, and training to Scheduled Tribe candidates preparing for the Civil Services Examination.

fields.schemeName: Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)
fields.briefDescription: "Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)" provides awards ranging from ₹3,000/- to ₹51,000/- to the meritorious students from the Scheduled Tribe community based on their performance in the 10th and 12th board examinations.

fields.schemeName: Post Metric Scholarship (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic)
fields.briefDescription: The "Post-Metric Scholarship" scheme, implemented by the Department of Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial assistance to students from class 11 to college level, including medical, engineering, science other courses.

fields.schemeName: PURNA Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce malnutrition, anemia, and early marriage among adolescent girls in Gujarat by educating them on health, nutrition, life skills, and legal rights, while promoting self-empowerment through various activities.

fields.schemeName: Valmiki Chhatravritti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Valmiki Chhatravritti Yojana" by the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial assistance and encouragement to orphaned and differently-abled students to pursue higher education and benefits include full tuition fee reimbursement.

fields.schemeName: Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme for the Students Who Attain First Position in CBSE Annual Exams in the State
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Haryana State Meritorious Incentive Scheme" aims to encourage meritorious students who attain top positions in CBSE annual exams by providing them with financial incentives. Selected students receive an annual incentive covering their school/college fees up to their graduation.

fields.schemeName: Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Divyangjan Scholarship Scheme" provides financial assistance for the education and training of differently-abled children, who are regular students in a school or college. The application needs to be submitted to the District Office, Panchayat and Social Welfare / Janpad Panchayat Office.

fields.schemeName: e-Adhigam Scheme - Free Tablet
fields.briefDescription: This scheme was launched with objective of promoting digital education & providing online learning to children from poor & needy families, proving to be a boon for them. Under this scheme, free tablets are provided to students, enabling access to state-of-the-art software & learning materials.

fields.schemeName: Reimbursement of Tuition Fee and Transport Facility to Scheduled Castes Students Studying in Technical Institutions in Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Castes students pursuing AICTE-approved technical courses. Under this scheme, eligible students receive tuition fee reimbursement and transport facility benefits.

fields.schemeName: Free Books Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in govt. colleges will receive ₹2,000/- per annum for purchasing books.

fields.schemeName: Free Passport Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate higher education and global career opportunities for students by covering the cost of passport issuance. Under this scheme, final-year UG and PG students in government colleges receive reimbursement for passport application fees.

fields.schemeName: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in Govt. Colleges will receive a stipend of ₹1,000 per month.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from all sections of Rajasthan who are pursuing higher education at IITs, IIMs, and other national-level institutions. Under this scheme, 50% of the non-refundable fees are reimbursed to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Financial Assistance for Studying Bisexual Children
fields.briefDescription: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance of ₹6,000 per month for up to 12 months to transgender students from Class 6 and above for accommodation and daily needs if they live away from their homes for education.

fields.schemeName: Academic Scholarship Scheme (Labor Welfare Board Madhya Pradesh)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, up to two children of workers employed in industrial institutions/establishments covered under the Board are eligible for scholarship benefits. The scholarship is provided to students from Class 5th to 12th and higher education, who have passed their previous class.

fields.schemeName: Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams
fields.briefDescription: The "Coaching Help Scheme for JEE-GUJCET-NEET Exams" scheme provides financial assistance to non-reserved category students from the science stream who are getting coaching in institutions with three years or more experience.

fields.schemeName: Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations
fields.briefDescription: The "Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations" scheme provides financial assistance to non-reserved category students who are undergoing training in recognized institutions for competitive recruitment examinations.

fields.schemeName: Uchch Shiksha Puraskar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: "Uchch Shiksha Puraskar Yojana" aims to encourage and motivate students from weaver families to pursue higher education. ₹20,000/- is provided to talented students from weaver families who get admission in first year of Engineering/Medical/CA/MBA courses in any government college in Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for the Children of Parents/Guardians Engaged in Unclean and Hazardous Occupations - Goa
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to children whose parents belong to Other Disadvantaged Categories, supporting their education at pre-matric level. This initiative seeks to enhance student participation & reduce dropout rates, particularly during the transition from primary to upper

fields.schemeName: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a grant of ₹15,000/- is provided from the Amalgamated Fund to the children of ex-servicemen who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching.

fields.schemeName: Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to motivate meritorious Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan by providing one-time financial assistance of ₹3,500/- to those pursuing regular college courses and achieving first division.

fields.schemeName: Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students belonging to Special Backward Classes (SBC). It provides an annual financial incentive of ₹3,500/- to students pursuing education from Class 10th to postgraduate level in government schools or colleges.

fields.schemeName: Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
fields.briefDescription: "Merit cum Means Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized Polytechnic Institutions in Chhattisgarh.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Higher Education/Technical Education
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.

fields.schemeName: Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students
fields.briefDescription: The "Awarding Teleeducation Scholarships To Afghan Students" scheme under e-VidyaBharati Network Project, launched by the Ministry of External Affairs, offers 1000 annual scholarships to Afghan students for UGC-approved online UG and PG programs from Indian universities.

fields.schemeName: Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- along with a certificate of appreciation is awarded to top 100 meritorious students of Class 10 & each stream of Class 12, who are listed in state-level merit list of Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer.

fields.schemeName: Tiatr Competition
fields.briefDescription: The "Tiatr Competition" aims to encourage and promote the unique Goan theatre form of Tiatr. Participation in this scheme is open to Goan institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (with renewed registration). Entries are invited through press notes in local dailies.

fields.schemeName: Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to 5,800 girl students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS), who are studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

fields.schemeName: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are studying in Sanskrit schools from Class 6 to Class 12 in Uttarakhand by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to invite scholars from any state in India to submit research manuscripts on Sanskrit literature, as well as socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Kavi Sammelan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote and popularize Sanskrit language and literature by encouraging poets who compose and recite in Sanskrit. 15 poets from Uttarakhand and other states are invited to present their works at national/state festivals, each receiving ₹2501/-.

fields.schemeName: Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saharia Area of Rajasthan to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme.

fields.schemeName: Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Harit Kaushal Vikas Karyakram" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to impart eco-based livelihood skills to youth and communities in the Himalayan regions.

fields.schemeName: Skill Development
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Skill Development" by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, aims to impart practical training to postgraduate students in various Earth Science disciplines, including structural and evolutionary geology, geochemistry, geomorphology, glaciology, magnetostratigraphy, etc.

fields.schemeName: Student Program Under AcSIR
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" implemented by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), aims to promote high-quality research and leadership development in Earth Sciences through doctoral education. It provides research opportunities to geoscience postgraduate students.

fields.schemeName: Skill Development
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Skill Development" by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, aims to impart practical training to postgraduate students in various Earth Science disciplines, including structural and evolutionary geology, geochemistry, geomorphology, glaciology, magnetostratigraphy, etc.

fields.schemeName: Student Program Under AcSIR
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" implemented by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), aims to promote high-quality research and leadership development in Earth Sciences through doctoral education. It provides research opportunities to geoscience postgraduate students.

fields.schemeName: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.

fields.schemeName: Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC” by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, supports education for Minority Caste students by providing a monthly stipend for one year.

fields.schemeName: CA/ICWA CMA /CS Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students from minority religious communities studying Chartered Accounts/Cost & Management Accounts/Company Secretaryship courses. Through this scheme, a scholarship is provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Swayam Saksham Scheme (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)

fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the education of poor students by offering scholarships from class 1st to 10th in government and aided schools.

fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing scholarships to meritorious students of Prathmik Madhyama (Class 10) and Uttar Madhyama (Class 12) in Sanskrit schools who secure the highest marks.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Gyansetu Merit Scholarship Yojana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme introduced by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support meritorious students by providing scholarships from Class 6th to Class 12th in selected schools.

fields.schemeName: Namo Laxmi Yojana

fields.schemeName: Conducting Outreach Programmes in Various Fields

fields.schemeName: Super-100 Programme - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to identify and support the brightest Class 12 Science stream students by providing them with high-quality coaching and guidance for engineering and medical entrance examinations. fields.schemeName: Government of Mizoram Incentive Cash Award Scheme To Successful Candidates for Central and All India Service Examination
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage educated youth among the citizens of India and bonafide residents of Mizoram who aspire to succeed entry to Central and All India Services, addressing the issue of Mizo educated youths lagging behind and becoming increasingly marginalized in examinations.

fields.schemeName: Margadeepam Scholarship

fields.briefDescription: In Madhya Pradesh, Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Residential School Scheme for Boys (Class 1-8) Introduce by the School Education Department. fields.schemeName: Establishment of Digital Learning Platform
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to establish Digital Learning Platform to provide training and career counseling on various subjects, including ICT orientation, emerging technologies, and more, through both online and offline modes for students of secondary schools across the state.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. fields.schemeName: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and boys from the General category who fall under the BPL category.

fields.schemeName: Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions at various levels. Under this scheme, Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories.

fields.schemeName: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Dr. V.N. Mathur Award (M.Sc. Mathematics)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support and encourage meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Mathematics, thereby assisting them and reducing their financial burden. The assistance of ₹20,000/- per year is provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Swanath Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to diploma and graduate-level students who are orphans, whose parents or either parent has died due to COVID-19, or who are dependents of martyrs from the military or central armed forces.

fields.schemeName: Research Assistantship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide research assistantship to undergraduate and postgraduate research scholars to support their academic and research activities.

fields.schemeName: Samaaveshit Shiksha
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.

fields.schemeName: Son/Daughter Education Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered building and construction workers pursuing education from Class I up to higher education or professional courses.

fields.schemeName: “Ishan Uday” Special Scholarship Scheme For North Eastern Region
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Education and the University Grants Commission. Taking special interest with regard to the promotion of higher education in the NER, i.e. for improving the GER, promoting higher education, and encouraging children belonging to the economically weaker sections.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was introduced from the Academic year 2006-07 to encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of Ex-servicemen/ Ex-Coast Guard personnel and their widows.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Vidyarthi Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to school and college students in the form of scholarships of upto ₹2,400/- per month to students from IRDP/BPL Families bonafide in Himachal Pradesh, and pursuing their study in Govt / Govt Aided Institutions in Himachal Pradesh.

fields.schemeName: Banishree Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The aim provides assistance and encourages them to study as well as acquire technical/ professional/ vocational training.

fields.schemeName: Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The "Gopabandhu Sikhya Sahayata Yojana" scheme was launched as an endeavor to make higher education inclusive and to increase the gross enrollment ratio. The scheme aims to further widen access to higher education for students belonging to underprivileged sections of society.

fields.schemeName: Thakur Sen Negi Utkrisht Chatravriti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to provide scholarships of ₹11,000/-per annum to the top 100 Girls and top 100 Boys students belonging to the Tribal Community of Himachal Pradesh who have passed Class 10th and presently studying in a recognized institution within or outside the State.

fields.schemeName: Distance Education Scholarship–Scholarship For Disabled Students Pursuing Degree, PG Courses
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Distance Education Scholarship–Scholarship for Disabled Students Pursuing Degree, PG Courses” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: NEC Stipend And Book Grant Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote national integration, global understanding, social responsibility, and encourage scientific, imaginative, and innovative thinking among students.

fields.schemeName: Snehapoorvam Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Kerala Government has launched a noble initiative “Snehapoorvam Scheme” to provide financial assistance to orphans who are living in the family, with their relatives, friends, or the support of the community under the Social Welfare Department implemented through Social Security Mission.

fields.schemeName: Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE
fields.briefDescription: AICTE in order to ensure the development of technical education in India awards Post Graduate Scholarship of ₹12,400/- per month to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to AICTE approved post-graduate programs in AICTE approved Institutions/University Dept. as per AICTE approved intake.

fields.schemeName: Attendance Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students with Disabilities of Rural Areas
fields.briefDescription: The objective of this scheme is to uplift the status of the girls with disabilities in the rural areas & also to make them reliant by paying incentives in the form of Attendance Scholarship to these girls.

fields.schemeName: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community

fields.schemeName: Combined Merit Scholarship

fields.schemeName: Uniform Assistance for Scheduled Tribe Students

fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Scholarship to Disabled Students" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department aims to provide financial assistance to students with disabilities. fields.schemeName: Food Bill Assistance for Medical & Engineering Students of Nomadic Tribes & Denotified Tribes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme supports students from Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes pursuing full-time Medical or Engineering courses in Gujarat by reducing their living expenses. fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide good coaching quality for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes candidates to enable them to appear in competitive examinations. Provides free coaching and stipend support to students from these marginalized communities.

fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide an opportunity and exposure to future graduates and postgraduates in Engineering and General Sciences to the research and development activities carried out by DRDO in state-of-the-art technology in fields relevant to the defense sector.

fields.briefDescription: NACO initiated the Internship Programme for young students who wish to engage with the Government. fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide annual financial assistance of ₹15,000, ₹10,000, and ₹5,000 for ST students in medical, engineering, and diploma courses, respectively.

fields.briefDescription: The "Assistance to Voluntary Organizations Working for Welfare of OBCs" scheme aims to involve the voluntary sector in improving the educational and socio-economic conditions of the target group i.e. OBCs to upgrade skills to enable them to start income-generating activities on their own.

fields.schemeName: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Diploma)
fields.briefDescription: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. fields.briefDescription: Biotechnology Career Advancement and Re-orientation (BioCARe) Programme, a special scheme of the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Ministry of Science & Technology, the government of India aims to enhance the participation of women scientists in India towards research in Biotechnology.
