fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakaar Putr/Putree Cycle Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 27 August 2015.

fields.schemeName: Education Assistance/Ph.D Scheme (GBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided once a year to any two children of a construction worker for the career development of bright and needy construction worker students seeking admission in the higher education courses of the state.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Nirman Shramikon Ke Bachon Hetu Nihshulk Coaching Sahaayata Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Labor Department of Chhattisgarh started this scheme on March 1, 2023, under the "Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board." The scheme provides free coaching assistance for children of construction workers.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Shramyogi Prathibhavan Vidyarthi Yojana (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board provides financial assistance for books, stationery, hostels, and laptops/computers for higher education to the meritorious children of registered construction workers.

fields.schemeName: Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Childrens (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: "Skill Upgradation and Vocational Education Scheme: For Worker's Children'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Dept. of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides full course fees, boarding and lodging assistance to the children of registered workers who acquire Skill from technical institutions.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Studies (BBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Resources Department, Govt. of Bihar. Under this scheme, educational financial support is provided to the children of registered workers who have been members of the Board for at least one year.

fields.schemeName: Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters
fields.briefDescription: "Stipend Scheme for Grandchildren of Freedom Fighters" aims to honour the third-generation descendants of freedom fighters by providing financial assistance for higher education. Eligible students receive a monthly stipend and an annual allowance for books to support their education.

fields.schemeName: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

fields.schemeName: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarship support for the education of registered drivers, conductors, and their dependents.

fields.schemeName: Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Nirman Shramikon Ke Bacchon Hetu Nishulk Ganvesh Evam Pustak Copy Hetu Sahaayata Raashi Yojana" for construction worker on 09 December 2022.

fields.schemeName: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Financial Assistance to the School Going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform
fields.briefDescription: "Grant of Financial Assistance to the School-going Children of Industrial Workers/Employees Studying in 1st to 4th Standard for Supply of One Set of Uniform" by the Dept of Labour & Employment, Goa, aims to provide financial assistance for the purchase of uniforms to school-going children.

fields.schemeName: Scholarships to Students Studying in Central Government Institution like IIT, IIM, IIIT, NIT and Central Universities
fields.briefDescription: The scholarship provides financial assistance to students from Tamil Nadu's BC, MBC, and DNC communities pursuing UG/PG courses at premier Central Government institutions like IITs, IIMs, IIITs, NITs, and Central Universities.

fields.schemeName: Labour Skill Training Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: Launched on 1st August 2018, the scheme "Labour Skill Training Scheme" is a skill development initiative by the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, Govt of MP. It offers free skill training to construction workers aged 18-45 years and their dependents aged 16-45

fields.schemeName: Green Passage Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Green Passage Scheme" Scheme provides free higher education to children without biological or adoptive parents. After the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, the scheme was revised to as well cover children who lost their both parents or single parent during the COVID-19 pandemic.

fields.schemeName: Vahli Dikri Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The Vahli Dikri Yojana by the Government of Gujarat under the Women and Child Development Department . The scheme supports girl children by providing financial aid, free education, and insurance, encouraging higher education and reducing dropout rates.

fields.schemeName: Safai Karmakar Ke Bachche Hetu Chhatravrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Ke Bachche Hetu Chhatravrtti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

fields.schemeName: Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakaar Ke Putr/Putri Hetu Vishesh Coaching Yojana" for unorganized worker on 28 April 2012.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the children (2 boys & 3 girls) of workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana at the time of admission to continue their studies.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Education- Haryana Silicosis Board
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to ₹12,000/- per year is given to the children of workers who are suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Haryana. Under this scheme, the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board.

fields.schemeName: Education Assistance - Folk Artist
fields.briefDescription: The "Education Assistance - Folk Artist" scheme was launched by the Art and Culture Department, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme provides financial assistance for the education of children of registered folk artistes.

fields.schemeName: Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha (K.B.O.C.W.W.B)
fields.briefDescription: The "Thayi Magu Sahaya Hastha'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Karnataka, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to registered women construction workers for pre-school education and nutritional support of their child for up to 3 years after delivery.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Merit Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers ₹3,000/- per year for five years to 1000 boys and 1000 girls from SC/ST communities, based on their plus 2 public examination marks, provided they continue their education.

fields.schemeName: Building And Other Construction Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The Skill Development & Technical Education Department launched the BOC Scholarship on 1 December 2022 so that the students pursuing or undertaking technical education will be able to pursue it finally without facing any kind of financial difficulties.

fields.schemeName: Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Educational Assistance to Children of Women Headed Families” was launched by the Social Justice Department, Government of Kerala. The scheme proposes to extend a helping hand to women-headed families by way of providing financial assistance to the education of children.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support higher education for dependent wards of States/UTs Police personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. Through this scheme, financial assistance for girls and boys per year is provided.

fields.schemeName: Madhyamik Drop-out Coaching
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide intensive coaching to Madhyamik dropout students and prepare them for the Madhyamik Examination. Through this scheme, coaching, honorarium for teaching staff, and stipends for candidates are provided to Madhyamik failed Scheduled Tribe (ST) students.

fields.schemeName: AICTE - Grant For Augmenting Infrastructure In North Eastern Region
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "AICTE - Grant for Augmenting Infrastructure in North Eastern Region (GAINER)" was introduced by AICTE to enhance the functional efficiency of the technical institutes located in far-flung areas of North East India, by addressing deficiencies in water, electricity, and internet.

fields.schemeName: Chief Minister’s Startup/innovation Projects/new Industries
fields.briefDescription: The HP CM Startup Scheme aims to turn the educated youth from job seekers to job creators. This scheme will give support to the “Startup” and Innovation Projects in the state and will provide skills to the youth and potential investors to develop entrepreneurship.

fields.schemeName: Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Goa State Best Library and Best Librarian Award" has been designed to envisage grant of awards for one meritorious Library and one Librarian serving either in any Government or Government–aided Libraries in the State of Goa, which includes the Public/Academic/Special/Research Libraries.

fields.schemeName: AICTE- TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY JOINT TRAINING PROGRAMS FOR TEACHERS
fields.briefDescription: AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Teachers has been launched to train faculty members to prepare them for being successful in a knowledge society.

fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Tribes
fields.briefDescription: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Tribe aims to provide support for the betterment of Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates for coaching and pre examination training in quality coaching institutions to enable them to appear in competitive examinations.

fields.schemeName: AICTE - YOUTH UNDERTAKING VISIT FOR ACQUIRING KNOWLEDGE (YUVAK): STUDY TOUR OF ATAL TUNNEL, HIMACHAL PRADESH
fields.briefDescription:
The scheme is intended for providing Financial Grant for conducting a Study Tour of ATAL TUNNEL
by Students / faculty of AICTE approved Institutions in the field of technical education.

fields.schemeName: AICTE SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME-SFURTI SCHEME
fields.briefDescription: Short Term Training Programme-SFURTI Program aims to provide financial assistance from AICTE to the institutions for conducting faculty and student trainings to enable faculty members and students in the field of technical education.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Margdarshan scheme
fields.briefDescription: Margdarshan Initiative has been introduced by All India Council for Technical Education in 2018 for facilitating the technical institutes in order to improve the quality of technical education as a whole through accreditation by providing access to the facilities available in host institute.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-ISTE INDUCTION/REFRESHER PROGRAMME SCHEME
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-ISTE Induction/ Refresher Programme provide financial assistance to AICTE approved institutions/universities in conducting training for the teaching faculties working in technical institutions.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses
fields.briefDescription: The “Financial Assistance to the Teachers/Lecturers Children who taken loan from Nationalised Banks for studying Medical/Engineering Courses” aims to provide financial assistance to the children of teachers/lecturers working in govt. & aided primary, secondary, graduate, & post-graduate institution.

fields.schemeName: Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The "Grant to Jharkhand State Unaided Educational Institutions" scheme by the Department of School Education and Literacy, Jharkhand Government provides financial assistance to unaided educational institutions for infrastructure and educational development.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Private Self-Financed Technical Institutions" scheme by the Higher, Technical Education & Skill Development Department, Government of Jharkhand, provides grants to private engineering and polytechnic institutions for infrastructure enhancement and quality education.

fields.schemeName: Fund of Funds for Startups
fields.briefDescription: Launched in January 2016 under Startup India, the Fund of Funds for Startups is managed by SIDBI. It supports DPIIT-recognized startups indirectly by investing in SEBI-registered AIFs, which must invest at least twice the FFS contribution.

fields.schemeName: Madhya Pradesh Non-Government Institution Grant Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support non-government cultural institutions by providing financial grants for cultural activities, training, equipment, and events.

fields.schemeName: Tagore National Scholarship for Cultural Research
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme has been introduced to invigorate and revitalize the various institutions under the Ministry of Culture and other identified cultural institutions in the country, by encouraging Scholars/academicians to affiliate themselves with these institutions to work on projects of mutual interest.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Interest Subsidy Eligibility Certificate (ISEC) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide concessional working capital loans at 4% interest to khadi institutions through interest subsidy support.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Free Distribution of Bicycles - DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: “Free Distribution of Bicycles'' under “Saraswati Vidya Yojana”, implemented by the Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide bicycles free of cost to all the girl students, studying in class VIII(8) in the Govt. schools.

fields.schemeName: PRL Junior Research Fellowships
fields.briefDescription: The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL), a prestigious institution under the Department of Space, Government of India, launched the Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) Program.

fields.schemeName: Sastraposhini Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Sastraposhini is a programme envisaged by Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE) for strengthening science education in schools of Kerala.

fields.schemeName: Industry Linked Biotechnology Research Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Scheme “Industry Linked Biotechnology Research Scheme (IBRS)” facilitates Academia-Industry interaction by undertaking projects in collaboration with an industrial partner which should result in commercializing the product or process or service.

fields.schemeName: Institutions of Eminence scheme
fields.briefDescription: Institutions of Eminence scheme has been launched in order to empower Higher Educational Institutions and to help them become world class teaching and research institutions.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-SHORT TERM TRAINING PROGRAMME (STTP) (UT-J&K,LADAKH AND NER)
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Short Term Training Program (STTP) intends to conduct faculty training through financial assistance from AICTE to enable faculty members in the field of technical education.

fields.schemeName: AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Librarians
fields.briefDescription: AICTE- Technical University Joint Training Programs for Librarians, aims to provide financial assistance in conducting training to librarians to prepare them for being successful and effective in a knowledge society.

fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes
fields.briefDescription: Scheme Of Coaching & Allied For Scheduled Castes aims to provide support for the betterment of Scheduled Caste (SC) candidates for coaching and pre examination training in quality coaching institutions to enable them to appear in competitive examinations.

fields.schemeName: Grant of Stipend to the Differently Abled Trainees of the Vocational Training Institutes
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, the differently abled persons undergoing any technical or professional training through Institutes are paid a fixed monthly stipend which will enable them to secure the training successfully in order to make their own earnings and become useful members of the society.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme (NSFDC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Under this Scheme, loan is provided for pursuing full-time Professional/Technical courses in recognized institutions as one time assistance.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Running Short-term Bridge Courses
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

fields.schemeName: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BC-A Students
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from Backward Classes (BC-A) families to support their education. Under this scheme, eligible students studying in Classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools receive a monthly stipend.

fields.schemeName: Sardar Patel National Unity Award
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, the highest civilian recognition in the field of national unity is provided to individuals or institutions demonstrating exceptional dedication to strengthening the unity of India.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports
fields.briefDescription: Training programs for Physical Education Trainers/Sport-Games Teachers/Director of Sports, aims to support institution in conducting trainings to develop the skill of the participants to involve the masses in traditional sports/games and fun games for physical activity through recreation.

fields.schemeName: AICTE Grant for Organizing Conference
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to institutions for organizing conferences in various fields of science and technology, management, and hotel management, including BBA, BCA and BMS institutions.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: IVRI Institute Scholarship For M.V.Sc. And Ph.D.
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Veterinary Research Institute will award scholarships to MVSc and PhD students who need financial assistance.his provision will be utilized to assist as many students as possible who have good academic record and who are making diligent efforts to pursue higher education.

fields.schemeName: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS)
fields.briefDescription: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS) has been introduced by the All India Council for Technical Education to support innovation & research across institutes with collaboration among TEQIP Faculty, Regular faculty of Project institutions (focus and non-focus) & Premier institutions of the country.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Non Governmental Organisations
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance to Non Governmental Organisations" scheme was launched by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons, Government of Tamil Nadu. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the NGO run a school for children with intellectual disability.

fields.schemeName: Home Nursing Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: "Home Nursing Scholarship" is a scholarship scheme by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa. Through this scheme, scholarships are provided to the students from Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes / Other Backward Class / Minorities and also to the Students with Disability.

fields.schemeName: Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Free Bicycle Distribution Scheme" by the Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to provide financial aid for bicycle purchases to Scheduled Caste (SC) students studying in Class 8th. Each student receives ₹3000 through DBT.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Development Assistance to Colleges for the Construction of Buildings
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide development assistance to Colleges to help in the consolidation and expansion of infrastructure. Financial assistance is provided to eligible Colleges for the construction and renovation of essential buildings like classrooms, laboratories, and hostels.

fields.schemeName: AICTE-PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT SCHEME
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-Professional Development Scheme enables meritorious faculty to interact at International Level Conferences, both within and outside India, Seminars, and Symposia.

fields.schemeName: Scheme For Campus Accommodation & Facilities Enhancing Social Experience
fields.briefDescription: "Scheme for Campus Accommodation & Facilities Enhancing Social Experience (CAFES)" was introduced by AICTE to provide financial assistance for construction of hostel to create a congenial study atmosphere free from the shackles of domestic shores so as to encourage students to purse their education.

fields.schemeName: AICTE - Scheme For Promoting Interests, Creativity And Ethics Among Students
fields.briefDescription: AICTE-SPICES scheme provides financial support to institutions for developing students' clubs for the well-rounded development of students by promoting their interests, creativity, and ethics. This club should serve as a model for other clubs in the institution and also those in other institutions.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance To Pre-primary School In Remote Areas
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to set up pre-primary schools in remote tribal areas, in the form of rent amount payable for the premises, fixed remuneration to one Teacher, one helper, teaching aid/equipment, toys, and mid-meal.

fields.schemeName: AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS)
fields.briefDescription:
AICTE e-Shodh Sindhu Scheme (eSS) provides subscriptions of e-Resources like Web of Science, Scopus,
ASME, ASCE and Bentham Science to institutions.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Chhatravas Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, students belonging to minority communities who are studying in a recognized institution, school, college, university, or technical institution in their respective districts and residing in minority hostels are provided a monthly stipend of ₹1,000/-.

fields.schemeName: One Act Play competition at High School, Higher Secondary School and College level (Konkani, Marathi & English)
fields.briefDescription: The "One Act Play Competition" is a Cultural Scheme by the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, encouraging students' personality development through theatre, with participation open to all Goan schools and colleges, and transport assistance provided as per government norms.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts duly registered under the Companies Act for their development
fields.briefDescription: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, provides Grants-in-Aid for supporting professional associations/ organisations of social scientists, companies and trusts  for their development.

fields.schemeName: Technology Development And Utilization Programme For Women
fields.briefDescription: In order to meet the specific needs of women and to enhance the contribution of women towards technology capability building, the “Technology Development & Utilization Programme for Women (TDUPW)” has been formulated by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).

fields.schemeName: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
fields.briefDescription: Through Idea Lab Scheme, AICTE will be setting up Idea Labs in AICTE approved institutions to encourage students for application of science, technology engineering and mathematics (STEM) fundamentals towards enhanced hands-on experience, learning by doing and even product visualization.

fields.schemeName: VAIshwik BHArtiya Vaigyanik (VAIBHAV) Fellowship
fields.briefDescription:
VAIBHAV Fellowship envisages collaboration between scientists of Indian Diaspora with
Indian Higher Educational Institutions/Universities/Public Funded Scientific
Institutions. Fellow would identify an Indian Institution for collaboration &
may spend upto two months in a year for a max. of 3 years.

fields.schemeName: Star College Scheme For Strengthening Of Science Education And Training At Undergraduate Level
fields.briefDescription: The Dept. of Biotechnology has launched "Star College Scheme for Strengthening of Science Education and Training at Undergraduate Level" for improving critical thinking and 'hands-on' experimental work at the undergraduate (college) level in sciences.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Khadi Karigar Janashree Bima Yojana
fields.briefDescription: A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death and disability of the insured member.

fields.schemeName: Modernisation And Removal Of Obsolescence
fields.briefDescription: MODROB scheme, one of the AICTE Quality Improvement Scheme (AQIS), intends to support the development of laboratories with appropriate equipment/ technology/ tools/ software and encourages financial contribution from the industry.

fields.schemeName: CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH): Pre-Matric Remedial Coaching
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide handholding support in the form of remedial coaching to students studying in government academic institutions or institutions receiving grant-in-aid support from the Government, who belong to minority, OBC or SC communities of the State of Manipur.

fields.schemeName: Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings
fields.briefDescription: "Grant-in-aid Scheme to Village Education Committees/Urban Education Committees for minor repairs of Government School buildings" was introduced by the Directorate of Education, Goa. The scheme provides grant-in-aid to address urgent minor repairs required in Government School buildings.

fields.schemeName: Establishment of Integrated Educational Complexes
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Establishment of Integrated Educational Complexes" by the Directorate of Education, Government of Goa, aims to address the inadequate infrastructure and congested conditions faced by government-aided educational institutions in urban areas such as Panaji, Margao, and Mapusa within Goa.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower: Scheme of Financial Assistance for Setting Up Anchor Institute
fields.briefDescription: The "Scheme for Enhancement of Technical Competence and Manpower" under the Gujarat Industrial Policy aims to bridge the industry’s skill gap, boost employment, and align workforce training with evolving technology and business needs.

fields.schemeName: Youth and Eco Club
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote environmental awareness and sustainable practices among students by organizing programmes and activities such as plastic reduction initiatives, kitchen gardening, etc. along with various competitions to engage and empower students in protecting the environment.

fields.schemeName: The Wired Internet Scheme for Information and Communication Technology Laboratory in Schools in the State of Goa
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide monthly rental reimbursement to avail internet services to the Information and Communication Technology Laboratory in Government and Government-Aided Schools in the State of Goa. It provides a maximum monthly reimbursement of ₹2,000/- for internet rental.

fields.schemeName: Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC- Haryana
fields.briefDescription: This scheme offers educational loans of up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹30 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized courses in India or abroad.

fields.schemeName: Access to Knowledge for Technology Development and Dissemination (A2K+)
fields.briefDescription: Access to Knowledge for Technology Development and Dissemination (A2K+) is a scheme targeted towards developing mechanisms to disseminate science, technology and innovation-related information to industries, research and academic institutions

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses - DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: “Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/ Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses'' under “Saraswati Vidya Yojana”, implemented by the Directorate of Education,  Of DNH & DD, aims to provide financial assistance to girl students pursuing higher education in professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna" is a government initiative launched to encourage the enrollment and retention of girl students in schools by providing them with school uniforms.

fields.schemeName: Punjabi Language Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: This scheme awards scholarships to students based on their merit in the Punjabi subject in the 8th and 10th class examinations conducted by the Haryana Board of School Education, provided they continue studying the Punjabi subject in the 9th and 11th classes.

fields.schemeName: Foreign Study Loan Scheme (GUEEDC)
fields.briefDescription: Loan scheme offering up to ₹15 lakh at 4% simple interest to unreserved category students for MBBS, PG, or equivalent courses abroad with flexible collateral and repayment conditions.

fields.schemeName: Sanction of Laptops - Andhra Pradesh
fields.briefDescription: The "Sanction of Laptops" scheme aims to distribute laptops to visually challenged, hearing impairments, speech impairments, and orthopedic challenges students pursuing professional courses. The A.P. Differently Abled & Senior Citizens Assistance Corporation proposes to procure 200 laptops.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhyamantri Balika Cycle Yojna" is a government initiative aimed at reducing the gender gap in secondary school enrollment by providing financial assistance to girls for purchasing bicycles, ensuring improved access to education.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Intermediate Pass)
fields.briefDescription: The Mukhyamantri Balika (Intermediate Pass) Protsahan Yojana is a scheme by the Bihar government aimed at promoting girl child education, curbing child marriages, reducing fertility rates, and empowering girls to become self-reliant.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana (Matriculation)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides a financial incentive to girls who achieve a first division in their matriculation examination.

fields.schemeName: Chhattisgarh Yuva Suchna Kranti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free laptops and tablets to eligible students in higher education institutions. The scheme intends to facilitate the use of new technologies among the state's youth, thereby fostering their economic and social development, and enhancing their knowledge and careers.
